Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: Мне не нужны дилетанты вроде тебя под ногами, когда я творю на кухне!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: Ты ещё здесь? Иди… поболтай с кем-нибудь другим.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: Йо, чувак. Я Frank. Hamsey говорит, вы знакомы сто-о лет. Друг Hamsey - мой друг, бро.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: Чё готовить - пока без понятия, но придумаю что-нибудь, как время придёт.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: Может, пирог? Возни мало, накосячить трудно, да?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#028.dst: Поговори с Hamsey и выбери повара-напарника.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: А, знакомство с tous mes cuisiners состоялось? С кем будешь работать?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: А, Brie! Отличный повар… и ещё лучший сыр! Шучу, шучу. Вы сработаетесь, я уверен.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: А, Kale. Один из самых талантливых моих поваров, хоть порой и упрям!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank! Пусть порой он кажется… расслабленным, уверяю, повар он весьма умелый!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maitenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: Maitenant, mon ami, ступай к своему повару и за дело!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about the dish.

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: Снова привет! Значит, варим Seasoned Voidroot Stew вместе? Ура!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: Это не так просто, как кажется, но вдвоём, думаю, справимся.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: Я уже говорила, что хочу себя доказать… Я здесь новенькая, и некоторые повара не одобряют моих идей. Это мой шанс!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: Я месяцами оттачивала рецепт Voidroot Stew и наконец могу показать всем, чего стою!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: Первое - [Snail Slime] с Snail Island! Для блюда хватит одной штуки.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: Дальше нужен [Voidroot], редчайший корень из глубин Пустоты. Говорят, кто-то в {p} может отвести тебя туда.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: И наконец [Moonsalt] - её, как известно, достать трудно. К счастью, у самозваного «Космического мага» Astralaus она должна быть: загляни к нему в башню и попроси!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: Вот и всё! Держи Книгу рецептов: ПКМ, чтобы открыть и следить за ингредиентами. Удачи!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.dst: Тьфу. Не путайся под ногами - и поладим.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: Приноси пользу: достань всё, что нужно. Болтать я не настроен.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: Не хочу, чтобы мою репутацию запятнал кто-то вроде тебя…
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: Главный ингредиент моего потрясающего омлета - конечно же [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], чего ты, конечно, не знаешь.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: Во-вторых, нужна [Snail Slime] с Snail Island, это очевидно. Любой опытный повар тебе скажет.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: И наконец, нужен [Говорящий гриб] с болотного Небесного острова - если, конечно, у тебя есть глаза.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.dst: УЖЕ ВЫЛЕТЕЛО ИЗ ГОЛОВЫ?? Я ЖЕ ВЕЛЕЛ ЗАПИСЫВАТЬ!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: Тебе повезло: хоть кто-то здесь толковый. Я всё записал в эту книгу рецептов. ПКМ, чтобы открыть. А теперь неси ингредиенты и брысь!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: Круто работать с тобой, чувак! Hamsey просто офигеет.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: Хмм, так какой пирог мы тут испечём?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: Я, может, и ленивый, но в готовке глаз у меня намётан. И по-моему, чувак, ты прям любитель Skyhigh Pie! Хе-хе.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: Ну, ты ж знаешь, как готовить простой Skyhigh Pie, да? Давай, двигай, я подожду тут, пока принесёшь ингредиенты.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: Хе-хе, да шучу я, бро! Надо было видеть твоё лицо.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: Крупное [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] добавит огоньку. Хотя не столько, сколько добавят тебе grook, если застукают за кражей яиц!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: И наконец секретный ингредиент - [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Штука отличная, но далековато. Прогулка ещё никому не вредила, да? Не то чтобы я сам пробовал.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: Ха, память плохая? У меня тоже, бро. Держи Книгу рецептов: ПКМ, чтобы открыть и глянуть, где брать ингредиенты!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: Как соберёшь всё - возвращайся. Бывай, чувак!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#062.src: Collect [{~} {Ingredient}] at [X, Y, Z] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#062.dst: Собери [{~} {Ingredient}] в [X, Y, Z] или сверься с книгой рецептов.

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: Это Астральный дом Astralus! Сможешь подняться, меняя гравитацию?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: Астрономический прогресс! Но это только начало!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: Мою Moonsalt? Какая нелепость! Я свою добыл сам, а ты добудь свою! Всё честно.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: Проклятые люди, вечно не слушаете! Я сказал… Иди. И. Добывай.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: Что приводить тебя сюда, чужачок? Какие у тебя названия? Лю-ди? Мы занимать Людины! Плохой выбор, бери другое, чужачок!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: Расследовать для помогать? Сколько удобностей! Людины требовать помогание! Смотри, людины провалолетать в большой кратер-камень!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: Жгимолоко кончиться, и одно направление добыть его - moonsalt! Мы ударить удачнугет и найти moonsalt на кратер-камне!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: Очищенный moonsalt давать жгимолоко для космовжуха! Неудобствие: космовжух уничтожен. Людины создать крохотный космовжух!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: Только единичный людин влезать в нынешний космовжух. Чужачок помогать - людины пускать чужачка в космовжух. Новый людины создать в данное время!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: Людины жить на кратер-камне, ждание не давать смерть-результат!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: Moonsalt обнаружиться в соль-пещере на север, чужачок идти по тропе!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: Только [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] нужно для жгимолоко, остаток чужачок может хватать!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: Когда чужачок иметь moonsalt, очищать в устройстве возле людина и вжух в космовжух!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: Привет и до-обро пожаловать на Трек Века!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: Один победитель, один проигравший. А Usnail Bolt ест проигравших на завтрак.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: Завтрак? Стоп, я завтракал? Перекусить было бы неплох-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: Ну да неважно. Что скажешь, искатель приключений? Сразись в гонке с Usnail Bolt. Главный приз - Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: Жаль, могла выйти славная гонка. До встречи, искатель приключений!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: Так-так-так… похоже, Usnail Bolt снова победил. Опять.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: Не твой день, человек. Что ж, цену проигрыша ты знаешь. Стража!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: Ого! В этой потрясающей гонке человеку удалось вырвать лидерство прямо из-под носа Usnail Bolt!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: Держи, человек. Эта слизь - твой приз.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: НУ РАЗВЕ НЕ ПРЕКРАСНО. ЧЕЛОВЕК?! КТО БЫ МОГ ПОДУМАТЬ.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: ТЫ УЖЕ СЕДЬМОЙ ПРОХОЖИЙ ЗА ДЕНЬ, И НИЧЕМ НЕ ЛУЧШЕ ОСТАЛЬНЫХ.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: И У КАЖДОГО ТАКОЕ ТУПОВАТО-ОВЕЧЬЕ ЛИЦО, БУДТО ГОВОРЯЩИЙ ГРИБ - ГРОМ СРЕДИ ЯСНОГО НЕБА.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: ДАЙТЕ ПЕРЕДОХНУТЬ, НАДОЕЛИ ГРУБИЯНЫ, ЧТО ВЫДИРАЮТ МЕНЯ БЕЗ ВСЯКОГО УВАЖЕНИЯ. ЛИЧНОЕ ПРОСТРАНСТВО, НЕ?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: К ЧЕМУ СТАРАТЬСЯ. ГЛЯНЬ НА СЕБЯ! БЕСТОЛОЧЬ. ЧТО, ПОТАЩИШЬ МЕНЯ В ДУРАЦКОЕ ПРИКЛЮЧЕНИЕ ПО НЕБЕСНЫМ ОСТРОВАМ?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: НАДЕЮСЬ, НЕТ. Я УЖЕ ЛИШИЛСЯ НОЖКИ СЕГОДНЯ: КАКОЙ-ТО ОЛУХ ПЫТАЛСЯ МЕНЯ УКУСИТЬ… ЖИВЬЁМ!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: НЕУЖТО ПОТАЩИШЬ МЕНЯ В ДУРАЦКОЕ ПРИКЛЮЧЕНИЕ ПО НЕБЕСНЫМ ОСТРОВАМ? ПРЕЛЕСТНО.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: НА КУХНЮ, ГОВОРИШЬ? ЧТО Ж, ЕСЛИ ЭТО ПОСКОРЕЕ ПРЕКРАТИТ МОИ МУЧЕНИЯ, ПОЧЕМУ БЫ И НЕТ.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: СТОЙ, ЗАЧЕМ ТЫ ПИХАЕШЬ МЕНЯ В СУМКУ? КАК МНЕ ТУТ ДЫШАТЬ?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: Привет! Вижу, без Рассветной муки тебе прямо мука, да?
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: Нужна сдобно… то есть срочно? Не беда, друг!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: Хоть мажь меня маслом и зови тостом: мука-то кончилась, ни щепотки не осталось.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: Прости, что валяю тут батон, но я хоть знаю, как сделать ещё.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: Видишь пшеничное поле рядом с пекарней? Собери пшеницу и отнеси на мельницу.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: Возьми косу у торговца по сдобству… по соседству и за работу!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: Мели сколько хочешь, хлеба на сегодня я уже напёк.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: Здорово, приятель! Ищешь Skyhigh Raspberries? Для пирога - самое то!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: Если интересно, доступ на остров стоит всего {~} изумрудов.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: Жить на что-то надо, вот я и соорудил систему пушек, что закинет тебя прямо на их остров!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: Ну, что скажешь? Малая цена за маленькое приключение, и малины - сколько съешь!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: Отлично! Иди на тот остров рядом со мной и прыгай в пушку - совершенно безопасно, клянусь!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: Поднимись на остров и собери сколько хочешь малины! Как закончишь, прыгай в большую пушку и вернёшься на берег!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: Ладно, без проблем. Захочешь малины - возвращайся!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: Так, отойди и дай мне заняться готовкой, просто передай ингредиенты!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: Ага! Должно получиться! Надеюсь, я всё сделала правильно… но ого, ты только глянь на цвет этого супа!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: Отнеси его Hamsey, узнаем, что он скажет!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.dst: Всё при тебе? Ну и долго же.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: Приступим. Остальные давно закончили. Отойди, пока я творю магию.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: Муа! Мой шедевр готов. Подай его шефу, уверен, он будет в восторге!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: И неси ОСТОРОЖНО. Когда я прославлюсь, это блюдо будет стоить СОТНИ!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: Я только чуть-чу-уть этой малины возьму - комиссия повара, а? Ну, приступим!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: Держи, бро. Приятно было поработать - отнеси это Hamsey, посмотрим, что скажет. Смотри не «потеряй» по дороге кусочек - сам знаешь, что говорят про свой товар!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
Recipe For Disaster#123.dst: Поговори с Hamsey, взяв готовое блюдо.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: А, блюдо готово? Что ж, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: Пройдём в мой личный обеденный зал… сюда!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#126.dst: Встреться с Hamsey в обеденном зале: [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: С возвращением, mon ami! Вижу, ты с блюдом в руках!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: Рагу? Кажется простым, но и простейшее в жизни может быть le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: Искатель приключений, это точно твоё блюдо? Так вкусно, что впору закрыть ресторан!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: Ты не перестаёшь меня удивлять, друг. Держи фартук - без него настоящему повару никак.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: Не могу не заметить, что твоё блюдо готово!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: Дай отведать, а я отвечу тем же! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami. Уж лучше укусить мула за derrière! Это… даже Gert не притронулся бы!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: Вижу, успехов в кулинарии у тебя нет. Оставь меня и возвращайся, когда поймёшь, что такое хорошая еда!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: С возвращением, и не с пустыми руками. Прошу, покажи, что получилось!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: Пирог? Похоже, тебе помогал Frank. Он просто обожает печь пироги!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: Вижу, твои compétences culinaires весьма развиты!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: Настоящим поваром я тебя пока не назову, но ты très bien! Прими эту награду в честь успеха!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Reclaiming the House#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#000.dst: Присоединись к Elphaba в Temporary Camp: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#001.dst: О, солдат Wynn в такой глуши? Вот кто нам сейчас нужен! Поможешь, если сможешь?
Reclaiming the House#001.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: Отлично, спасибо. Только сперва запру лагерь, потом введу в курс дела.
Reclaiming the House#002.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#003.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#003.dst: Меня зовут Elphaba. Я уже немало лет служу в армии Gavel.
Reclaiming the House#003.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#004.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#004.dst: Я командир аванпоста {p} впереди. Это крепость для надзора за столицей орков.
Reclaiming the House#004.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#005.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#005.dst: Долго там было спокойно, но недавно орки стали куда наглее и злее.
Reclaiming the House#005.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#006.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#006.dst: Они захватили аванпост - пришлось отступить и разбить лагерь, чтобы следить за местом, откуда мы следили за ними!
Reclaiming the House#006.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#007.src: I need more firepower if I'm going... to get...
Reclaiming the House#007.dst: Мне нужно больше сил, если я хочу… вернуть…
Reclaiming the House#007.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#008.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#008.dst: …о нет. Видишь, об этом я и говорю! Орки идут!
Reclaiming the House#008.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#009.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#010.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.

Reclaiming the House#011.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#011.dst: Третья атака за три дня! Сколько же у них подкреплений?!
Reclaiming the House#011.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#012.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#012.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#013.dst: Поговори с Elphaba о грядущей атаке.

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: Уф, кажется, это все… Подойди, продолжим, где остановились.
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: Вряд ли я справилась бы одна. Как же вовремя ты здесь, солдат.
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: Ясно одно: чтобы отбить аванпост, мне нужно больше сил.
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: Драться ты умеешь, и помощь мне пригодится, но нужен план, и быстро.
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: У аванпоста есть старая башня - бывшее зернохранилище. Она выше форта, оттуда можно следить за ними.
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: Рискованно, она слишком близко, но выбора нет. Жду у башни к юго-востоку отсюда, осмотримся.
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#020.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#020.dst: Дойди до сторожевой башни на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], чтобы спланировать атаку.

Reclaiming the House#021.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: Солдат! Я прямо за тобой. Отсюда видно наш аванпост и ту башню.
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#022.dst: Надо найти путь внутрь. Многих солдат штурм орков застал врасплох.
Reclaiming the House#022.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#023.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#023.dst: Если внутри есть выжившие, спасти их - первое дело.
Reclaiming the House#023.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#024.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: В конце концов, это лишние руки. Хотя рассчитывать на это нельзя…
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#025.dst: Скорее внутрь, пока орки нас не заметили!
Reclaiming the House#025.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#026.dst: Войди в сторожевую башню на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], чтобы спланировать атаку.

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: Так, обзор отличный. Посмотрим, что там творится…
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's... kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: Что- Не может быть! В центре - солдат заперли в клетке, а не убили? Это… даже облегчение.
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: Орков на площади слишком много, вдвоём нам не справиться…
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: …но клетка висит на тех верёвках. Перережем их - и солдаты смогут помочь!
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may no be an option...
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: Так, осталось понять, как нам обоим пробраться… По периметру часовые, так что через стену, пожалуй, не выйдет…
Reclaiming the House#031.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#032.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: Может, проследим, как ходят часовые, и найдём брешь-
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#033.dst: Люди на старый башня! Junhur стрелять! Это теперь наше место, вон!!
Reclaiming the House#033.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#034.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: Ах, только не сейчас! Так и знала… Выйти не успеем… Держись!!
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: Старый башня упасть! Junhur лучший пушкарь!!
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#036.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#036.dst: Ах, солдат!! Всё в порядке? Куда тебя унесло?!
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: Ох… Ого. Ни царапины. Тебе явно крупно повезло.
Reclaiming the House#037.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: А вот мне меньше… Меня здорово помяло. Хоть один из нас в порядке…
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#039.dst: Увы, значит, искать путь внутрь придётся тебе. Отсюда, снизу, часовых не видно.
Reclaiming the House#039.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#040.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: Я выживу, конечно, но какое-то время не смогу ни ходить, ни защищаться.
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#041.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#041.dst: Не хочется бросать тебя вот так, но утешу: силы - или везения - тебе хватит, чтобы прорваться.
Reclaiming the House#041.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#042.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: Осмотри окрестности аванпоста. Найди путь внутрь, но осторожнее, ладно?
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: Осмотри окрестности аванпоста и найди другой путь внутрь.

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: Иди по грязному следу орка. Он ведёт к пещере на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: Перережь верёвки и освободи стражу из клетки.

Reclaiming the House#049.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#049.dst: Ловко придумано с грязью, солдат! Они ничего не заподозрили, помоги нам!
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: Убей Orcish Overtaker, остальных мы отвлечём!
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Open the gate with a spell

Reclaiming the House#052.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: Overtaker повержены, орки в смятении! Открой вход в аванпост заклинанием, тут мы справимся!
Reclaiming the House#052.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#054.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#054.dst: Фух… Отличная работа, солдат! Аванпост снова наш!
Reclaiming the House#054.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: Рада, что здесь больше умелых рук из Wynn. Кстати, я не расслышала имя. Не скажешь?
Reclaiming the House#055.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#056.src: {u}, huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#056.dst: {u}, значит? Запомню. Моя помощь тебе почти не понадобилась, хех… Жаль, что я была обузой, но всё обошлось.
Reclaiming the House#056.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: Вот - мои личные сбережения, в благодарность.
Reclaiming the House#057.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#058.dst: Так, все, наводим порядок! Всё починить на случай новой атаки!!
Reclaiming the House#058.speaker: Elphaba

Recover the Past#000.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Recover the Past#000.dst: …он не знает. Придётся тебе ему сказать.

Recover the Past#001.src: Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#001.dst: Хмф. Может, нужно больше силы… Если вложить в заклинание больше маны, то-

Recover the Past#002.src: In the meantime, with our subject gone, we'll have to make do with another. There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#002.dst: А пока, раз подопытного нет, обойдёмся другим. Сегодня дежурит разведчик Reynauld, тоже родом из Fruma, как и ты.

Recover the Past#004.src: It's puzzling, to be sure... if only we could see further. I'll get to work immediately- we must know more!
Recover the Past#004.dst: Загадка, бесспорно… если бы видеть дальше. Сейчас же возьмусь за работу - нам нужно знать больше!

Recover the Past#005.src: Use your Movement Keys to Preview your move, then press Jump to Confirm.
Recover the Past#005.dst: Клавиши движения - выбрать ход, прыжок - подтвердить.

Recover the Past#007.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#007.dst: Успех! Успех, успех, УСПЕХ! Я гений, умнейший из живых!
Recover the Past#007.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#008.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#008.dst: Эй, случайный зевака! Ты - свидетель магического чуда! Я только что вернул себе воспоминания многолетней давности!
Recover the Past#008.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#009.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#009.dst: Ты ведь из Fruma, да? Значит, знаешь не хуже меня, что память о прежней жизни исчезла. Пуф. Нету!
Recover the Past#009.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#010.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#010.dst: Но с этим устройством… всё изменится! Вернём утраченное! Восстановим… ну, суть ясна.
Recover the Past#010.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#011.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#011.dst: Мне позарез нужны подопытные… Ты подойдёшь, да, но сперва надо убедиться, что штука работает.
Recover the Past#011.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#012.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#012.dst: Слушай! Есть предложение. Хочешь вернуть память? Приведи мне подопытных - и я покажу тебе утраченное!
Recover the Past#012.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#013.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#013.dst: Так, посмотрим… Нужны уроженцы Fruma. Здесь таких несколько.
Recover the Past#013.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#014.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#014.dst: Начни с горе-моряка Caid. Он сразу за {p} - иди по тропе до реки.
Recover the Past#014.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#015.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#015.dst: А я пока подкручу тут кое-что… Работает ещё не идеально. Большие куски моей памяти всё ещё пусты… Хм? Ты ещё здесь? Иди!
Recover the Past#015.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#016.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#016.dst: Найди моряка Caid у его лодки на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#017.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#017.dst: Ну? Я дал задание, что ты тут делаешь? Иди найди моряка Caid. Он сразу за {p}, иди по тропе до реки.
Recover the Past#017.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#018.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#018.dst: А? О! Я, э-э, тут не на что смотреть! Просто… любуюсь своим старым добрым кораблём!
Recover the Past#018.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#019.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#019.dst: Тебя прислал Picard? Тот, что засел в башне? Хех. Хорошо, что он наконец закончил. Но зачем я ему?
Recover the Past#019.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#020.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#020.dst: …Посмотреть мои воспоминания о Fruma? Не уверен. Раз их нет, значит, на то есть причина. Мне-мне и тут хорошо! Не надо мне знать ничего про…
Recover the Past#020.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#021.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#021.dst: …Ладно, так и быть. Схожу проверить память. Только сперва окажи услугу, лады?
Recover the Past#021.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#022.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#022.dst: Я вроде как мастер. Решил попробовать построить корабль - и вот он! Недурно, а?
Recover the Past#022.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#023.src: That's what I'm talkin' about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#023.dst: Вот! Съел, Reynauld? Знал, что кому-то понравится!
Recover the Past#023.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#025.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#025.dst: Эй! Хех, ну, тут не поспоришь. Я слепил его в основном из хлама, что валялся вокруг. Но для кучи металлолома впечатляет, скажи?
Recover the Past#025.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#026.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#026.dst: Только обещай не говорить Reynauld, но… Кое-какие редкие детали - из казарм стражи. Ничего серьёзного! Так, отщипнул сверху…
Recover the Past#026.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#027.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived at the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#027.dst: Мне не хватает последней детали, и, видишь ли… Кузнецу как раз привезли партию… Понимаешь, к чему я клоню?
Recover the Past#027.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#028.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#028.dst: Достань мне деталь у кузнеца - и я пойду с тобой в башню Picard. Не бросать же малышку недостроенной, верно?
Recover the Past#028.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#029.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#029.dst: Укради ящик из дома кузнеца на [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#030.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#030.dst: Ну как, ящик у тебя? Он у кузнеца, недалеко отсюда, в {p}. Только не попадись!
Recover the Past#030.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#031.src: Bring the package to Caid at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#032.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#032.dst: …А вот и ты! Как всё прошло? Давай сюда товар.
Recover the Past#032.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#033.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#033.dst: Кузнец ничего не видел, да? Боюсь, Reynauld уже идёт по моему следу…
Recover the Past#033.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#034.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#034.dst: А, неважно! Наконец-то доделаю свою старушку!
Recover the Past#034.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#035.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#035.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#036.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#036.dst: Точно! Любому уважающему себя кораблю нужен колокол. Без него всё не то.
Recover the Past#036.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#037.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#037.dst: Что за тон! Любому уважающему себя кораблю нужен колокол, ясно? Думаешь, паром без него хоть раз показался бы? Вот и я так думаю!
Recover the Past#037.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#038.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#038.dst: Ну… раз уговор с твоей стороны исполнен, придётся и мне свой исполнить!
Recover the Past#038.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#039.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#039.dst: Веди в башню Picard! Посмотрим, что прячется в моей большой башке.
Recover the Past#039.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#040.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#040.dst: Приведи Caid к доктору Picard в башню на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#042.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#042.dst: Ага! Вернулись! Хорошо, хорошо, отличная проверка моих доработок…
Recover the Past#042.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#043.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#043.dst: …Ясно. И этому доктору мы доверяем мою память?
Recover the Past#043.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#044.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#044.dst: Ну-ну, не недооценивай мой гений. Всё будет хорошо! Наверное. Шансы девяносто пять, ну, девяносто процентов. Вставай сюда.
Recover the Past#044.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#045.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#045.dst: Ладно… Надеюсь, вы знаете, что делаете, доктор…
Recover the Past#045.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#046.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#046.dst: А теперь осталось лишь… Запустить заклинание тут, щёлкнуть рычагом там, и…
Recover the Past#046.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#048.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#048.dst: Так, посмотрим, что у нас… Edwin, проверишь вон тот ящик?
Recover the Past#048.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#049.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#049.dst: Не вопрос. Слушай, Caid. Как ты всё время достаёшь такое? Тут дорогие детали, тебе они явно не по карману.
Recover the Past#049.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#050.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#050.dst: Ну… скажем так, последняя посылка снабжения для стражи чуть легче, чем могла бы быть.
Recover the Past#050.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#051.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#051.dst: Что? Caid, скажи, что ты не воруешь у стражи. Ты же знаешь, они не
Recover the Past#051.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#052.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#052.dst: Edwin, расслабься. Я лишь чуть отщипываю от их запасов. Одну-две посылки из тридцати не заметят.
Recover the Past#052.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#053.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#053.dst: И я их не боюсь. Они же нас защищать должны, так? Отделаюсь предупреждением, как все прошлые разы.
Recover the Past#053.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#054.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#054.dst: Ну… если ты так говоришь. Пожалуй, ты прав. Им столько припасов и не нужно. А мы найдём им куда лучшее применение!
Recover the Past#054.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#055.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#055.dst: Именно! Рад, что ты согласен. Ну, нашёл что-нибудь хоро
Recover the Past#055.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#056.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#056.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#058.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#058.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#059.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#059.dst: Хватит болтать. Вы двое, найдите сообщника.
Recover the Past#059.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#062.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#062.dst: Caid, ты арестован за неоднократные кражи имперского имущества.
Recover the Past#062.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#063.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#063.dst: По записям, за прежние проступки ты получил немало предупреждений. Это был последний шанс, и ты его упустил.
Recover the Past#063.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#064.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#064.dst: Отведите его в тюрьму на допрос и решите, что с ним делать.
Recover the Past#064.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#065.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#065.dst: Эй! Алло? Зевака-ставший-ассистентом! Выходи из транса, надо поговорить.
Recover the Past#065.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#066.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#066.dst: Хм. Хм-хм. Память оборвалась… Что бы мы увидели, если б
Recover the Past#066.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#068.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#068.dst: Да, похоже на то… Но, если поднять мощность, то… Да! Я ген
Recover the Past#068.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#069.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#069.dst: И это всё, что я есть?! Какой-то вор… Больше я ни на что не гожусь?
Recover the Past#069.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#072.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#072.dst: А! Зевака-ставший-ассис… знаешь, буду звать тебя ассистентом. Вижу, транс наконец прошёл.
Recover the Past#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#073.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#073.dst: Но это сейчас неважно! Важно то, что мы увидели! Воспоминания в ярких подробностях! Это устройство изменит мир!
Recover the Past#073.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#074.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested- so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#074.dst: …Хотя признаю, я запутался в хронологии. Caid арестовали - как же он оказался здесь, в Wynn, солдатом?
Recover the Past#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#075.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#075.dst: Чтобы узнать правду, нужны ещё подопытные! Сегодня дежурит разведчик Reynauld, тоже родом из Fruma, как и ты.
Recover the Past#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#076.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#076.dst: Да, хм. Он у моста к {p}. Рассчитываю, что ты уговоришь его на эксперимент. Во имя науки!
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#077.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#077.dst: Найди разведчика Reynauld у моста к {p} на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#078.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#078.dst: Хм… Где же лежит этот барьер? Магии не хватает, чтобы его пробить? Может, если поднять мощность…
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#079.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#079.dst: А! Ассистент! Ты что тут делаешь? Как там разведчик Reynauld? Он у моста к {p}.
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#081.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#081.dst: А, здравствуйте. В чём дело? Похоже, вам что-то от меня нужно.
Recover the Past#081.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#082.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#082.dst: Хм? Странный доктор хочет меня видеть? Вернуть мне память? Не скажу, что доверяю ему… но любопытно, сработает ли.
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#083.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#083.dst: Увы, должен отказаться. Не могу оставить пост. А если нападут осквернённые? {p} останется без защиты.
Recover the Past#083.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#084.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#084.dst: Хм, ну… Если ненадолго, может, и выйдет. Если обещаете помочь, коли нападут.
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#085.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#085.dst: Тогда решено. Я пойду с вами к доктору. Но сперва кто-то должен стоять на посту. Есть кто на примете?
Recover the Past#085.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#086.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do. I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#086.dst: Caid? Этот… жулик. Он ворует припасы, я знаю. Только доказать не могу. Но если он, по-вашему, годится - ладно.
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#087.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#087.dst: Недавно видел, как он шёл к храму. Может, передумал. Ведите к Caid, я за вами.
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#089.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#089.dst: Может, Caid передумал. Ведите к нему, я за вами.
Recover the Past#089.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#090.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#091.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#092.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#092.dst: Это мы, и у нас просьба. Наш общий друг хочет позвать меня на какой-то эксперимент.
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#093.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#093.dst: Только тогда {p} останется без защиты. Вот мы и спрашиваем: не постережёшь ли ты тут, пока я занят?
Recover the Past#093.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#094.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#094.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#095.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#095.dst: Не пойми неправильно, я бы не доверил {p} во… такому, как ты. Ты мне был не первый выбор, мягко говоря, и не второй, и не третий
Recover the Past#095.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#098.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#098.dst: Согласен? Что ж, проще, чем я думал. Помни: заметишь признаки атаки - беги в башню доктора и предупреди нас. Драку оставь профессионалам.
Recover the Past#098.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#099.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#099.dst: И в мыслях не было иного! Но подумай, Reynauld: может, прошлое забыто не зря.
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#100.src: Well, I suppose that settles that. Let's hurry to the doctor. I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#100.dst: Что ж, вопрос решён. Скорее к доктору. Не хочу ни минуты лишней оставлять {p} в этих ловких пальцах.
Recover the Past#100.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#101.src: Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#101.dst: Спасибо за помощь, Tasim и {u}. И Caid тоже…

Recover the Past#102.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#102.dst: Приведи Reynauld к доктору Picard в башню на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#103.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#103.dst: Скорее к доктору, не хочу ни минуты лишней оставлять {p} в этих ловких пальцах.
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#105.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#105.dst: А, ассистент! С возвращением, и с новым подопытным! Чудесно!
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#107.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#107.dst: Ну-ну, шагай вперёд. Не стесняйся! Прямо сюда! Смотри в сферу и сосредоточься на воспоминаниях.
Recover the Past#107.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#109.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#109.dst: Да-да! Не волнуйся, на Caid устройство испытано вдоль и поперёк. Быстренько запущу это… наложу заклинание тут… и…
Recover the Past#109.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#111.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#111.dst: А-а? Эй, кто там? Чего стучишь в такой час
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#113.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#113.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#114.src: N-no, of course not- Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#114.dst: Н-нет, конечно, можно- Э. Было бы неплохо, знаешь, если б ты предупредил, что придёшь!
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#115.dst: Сам знаешь, так дела не делаются. Ну, где товар?
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#116.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never oh, how was your week? Always just-...
Recover the Past#116.dst: Ну да… с тобой всегда сразу к делу. Никогда там «как неделя прошла?». Всегда только…
Recover the Past#116.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#117.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#118.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#118.dst: Я добыл детали из… э, одной из ближних фабрик. Надеюсь, это… наверное, то, что нужно.
Recover the Past#118.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#119.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#119.dst: …Хм. С фабрики, говоришь? И ты уверен, что тебя не видели? Если меня застанут с известным преступником, ты знаешь, чем это кончится для нас обоих.
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#120.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#120.dst: Н-нет. Не видели. Я, э… осторожничал. Ходил ночью. Ну, ты понял.
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#122.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you asked for.
Recover the Past#122.dst: Т-так… этого хватит? Я принёс, что ты просил.
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#123.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#123.dst: Ну… принёс, да. Но, Caid, ты знаешь, как я рискую, приходя сюда к тебе. Чтобы гарантировать твою безопасность, одного минимума мало.
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#124.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#124.dst: Я… хмф. Ладно, ладно, добавлю изумрудов. Чтоб сделка была слаще.
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#125.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#125.dst: Отлично. Приятно иметь дело, как всегда. Вернусь через пару недель.
Recover the Past#125.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#127.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#127.dst: А, Reynauld. Рад видеть. Входи, входи.
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#128.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#128.dst: Разрешите узнать, в чём дело, господин капитан?
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#129.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#129.dst: О, ничего особенного. Хотел лишь коротко обсудить твою службу.
Recover the Past#129.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#130.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#130.dst: Ты ведь понимаешь, что мы, служащие Её Величеству на столь почётных постах, обязаны блюсти… строгий кодекс чести, так?
Recover the Past#130.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#131.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#131.dst: Иначе как нам быть уверенными, что наши ряды чисты от проступков? Мы - пример для народа нашей великой провинции.
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#132.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to... bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#132.dst: Итак, что, по-твоему, будет, если кто-то из наших… обойдёт или нарушит кодекс чести? Какой прецедент это создаст?
Recover the Past#132.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#134.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#134.dst: Без всякой радости сообщаю: ты, Reynauld, лишаешься звания и арестован по обвинению в бесчестии и заговоре против Её Величества.
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#135.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#135.dst: Твоего сообщника, поставщика, поймали на днях. Говорят, он недолго колебался, прежде чем выдать твои секреты.
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#136.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#136.dst: Тебе нет места в наших рядах, Reynauld. Жаль, что до этого дошло.
Recover the Past#136.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#137.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#137.dst: Ассистент! Очнись! Нам ещё есть что обсудить.
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#139.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#139.dst: Изумительно! Ассистент, пока всё идёт отлично! Мы как никогда близки к разгадке тайны Fruma!
Recover the Past#139.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#141.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#141.dst: {u}!? Не думал встретить тебя так далеко отсюда!
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#142.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#142.dst: Любезности потом. Tasim? Что ты тут делаешь? Где Caid?
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#143.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#143.dst: Адмирал послал меня укрепить оборону {p}. Я думал встретить тебя у моста, но нашёл только Caid.
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#144.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#144.dst: Он сказал, что на {p} собираются напасть и что ты здесь, а потом сбежал.
Recover the Past#144.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#145.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#145.dst: Чёртов вор! Знал ведь, что нельзя уходить… Всё это было ошибкой… Чёрт.
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#146.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#146.dst: Некогда терять время. Идём, Tasim и {u}. Надо спасать {p}.
Recover the Past#146.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#147.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#147.dst: Этот Tasim, он ведь тоже из Fruma? Раз он твой товарищ, позови его в наш маленький эксперимент. Ради науки, конечно! Ну-ну, ступай. {p} нужно спасать!
Recover the Past#147.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#148.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#149.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#149.dst: Ассистент! Ты ещё здесь? Похоже, твоим друзьям нужна помощь!
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#150.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#150.dst: К тому же это шанс позвать Tasim в эксперимент! Хм, да, он наверняка будет интересным образцом!
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#151.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#151.dst: Они вот-вот двинутся на мост. Надо быть наготове.
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#153.dst: Хороший ответ, солдат. Мы их разобьём, сколько бы их ни было!
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#154.dst: Сперва сделайте, что нужно, но поскорее. Враг может появиться в любой момент.
Recover the Past#154.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#156.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#156.dst: Tasim, ты впереди, я прикрою сзади.
Recover the Past#156.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#157.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#157.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#158.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#158.dst: Уже недолго… Был бы тут Aledar - совсем как в старые времена. Правда?
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#159.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#159.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#161.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#161.dst: Чёрт. У вожака щит! Как его одолеть?
Recover the Past#161.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#162.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#163.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#163.dst: Верно! Tasim, {u}. Держите врагов подальше от меня, и я прицелюсь в шипы. Это наш единственный шанс его свалить.
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#164.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#164.dst: …Ах. Похоже, будет чуть труднее, чем думали. Но выложимся по полной!
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#165.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#166.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#166.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#167.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#167.dst: Reynauld! Что теперь? Так нам его не одолеть…
Recover the Past#167.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#168.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#168.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#169.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#169.dst: Tasim, {u}, сдерживайте их. Я что-нибудь придумаю, хоть что-то…
Recover the Past#169.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#170.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
