The Breaking Point#159.dst: Обычно я бы ни за что так не сделал, но времена отчаянные. Держи мой Верный Grappling Hook. С ним доберёшься до рычага.
The Breaking Point#159.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#160.src: It has limitations, though. It will only be able to latch onto those blue rocks on the walls - and I'll be taking it back once you're finished, thank you very much!
The Breaking Point#160.dst: Но есть ограничения. Он цепляется только за синие камни на стенах - и когда закончишь, я заберу его обратно, уж не обессудь!
The Breaking Point#160.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#161.src: Hey, {u}! Looks like you're doing good so far, but if you get stuck remember you can jump and then grapple mid-air, that might help on some of those trickier platforms!
The Breaking Point#161.dst: Эй, {u}! Пока всё идёт хорошо, но если застрянешь - помни: можно прыгнуть и зацепиться прямо в воздухе, это поможет на хитрых платформах!
The Breaking Point#161.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#162.src: Looks like that unlocked it, {u}! Get yourself back over here and I'll open the door.
The Breaking Point#162.dst: Похоже, открылось, {u}! Возвращайся сюда, я открою дверь.
The Breaking Point#162.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#163.src: There we are! Excellent work. You used that hook like a true expert! Ah, reminds me of the time-...
The Breaking Point#163.dst: Вот так! Отличная работа. Крюком ты орудуешь как настоящий мастер! Ах, помню, как-то раз-…
The Breaking Point#163.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#164.src: ...Ahem. Excellent work, indeed. With the override activated, I should be able to do the rest of the work to open the gate.
The Breaking Point#164.dst: …Кхм. Отличная работа, право. Рычаг включён, а остальное, чтобы открыть врата, я сделаю сам.
The Breaking Point#164.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#165.src: First, though, I'll be having that grappling hook back! Think of what could happen if you had free reign of that all over.
The Breaking Point#165.dst: Но сперва верни-ка Grappling Hook! Подумай, что было бы, дай тебе волю носиться с ним повсюду.
The Breaking Point#165.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#166.src: And so... I believe we have gone as far as we can.
The Breaking Point#166.dst: Итак… похоже, дальше нам не пройти.
The Breaking Point#166.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#167.src: This is True Ice, {u}. It has scarred this part of the Heights for centuries, ever since it was created by an ice dragon in my ancestors' conquest.
The Breaking Point#167.dst: Это True Ice, {u}. Веками он уродует эту часть Heights, с тех пор как его создал ледяной дракон в походах моих предков.
The Breaking Point#167.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#168.src: It cannot be melted or burned through by any means. It is why this location was chosen for their tomb. I'm afraid there is nothing more we can do.
The Breaking Point#168.dst: Его нельзя ни растопить, ни прожечь. Поэтому это место и выбрали для их гробницы. Боюсь, больше ничего не поделать.
The Breaking Point#168.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#169.src: At the end of the war, I imagine.
The Breaking Point#169.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#170.src: As the final dogun settlements fell, and as Garaheth was slain for the first time, my ancestors must have sealed them deep in this ice.
The Breaking Point#170.dst: Когда пали последние поселения Dogun и Garaheth был впервые убит, предки, видимо, запечатали их глубоко во льду.
The Breaking Point#170.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#171.src: The... actions of the Dwarves after winning the war are well documented. I would not be surprised if our accounts describe this imprisonment as a great victory.
The Breaking Point#171.dst: …Деяния дворфов после победы в войне хорошо задокументированы. Не удивлюсь, если наши летописи зовут это заточение великой победой.
The Breaking Point#171.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#172.src: The Dwarves, of course. Who else?
The Breaking Point#172.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#173.src: I believe it was General Algard of the Dwarven army to order the Elders' imprisonments.
The Breaking Point#173.dst: Думаю, заточить старейшин приказал Генерал Algard из армии дворфов.
The Breaking Point#173.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174.src: He was lauded as a hero, naturally. Now... we must reap the consequences of such a decision.
The Breaking Point#174.dst: Разумеется, его чествовали как героя. А теперь… нам пожинать плоды того решения.
The Breaking Point#174.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#175.src: True Ice is a material that cannot be melted or burned through by any means. Not even dogun magic has been able to make a dent.
The Breaking Point#175.dst: True Ice невозможно ни растопить, ни прожечь. Даже магия Dogun не оставила на нём и царапины.
The Breaking Point#175.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#176.src: ... I imagine why this location was chosen to hold the elders. A prison from which they would never be able to escape.
The Breaking Point#176.dst: …Понятно, почему старейшин держат именно здесь. Тюрьма, из которой им никогда не сбежать.
The Breaking Point#176.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#177.src: It is known for it to form naturally under extreme conditions... But the ice here is nowhere near natural.
The Breaking Point#177.dst: Известно, что он образуется сам в экстремальных условиях… Но здешний лёд совсем не природный.
The Breaking Point#177.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#178.src: It was formed by an Ice Drake's Breath partway through the war- and, well, as you can see, it has remained here ever since.
The Breaking Point#178.dst: Его создало дыхание Ice Drake посреди войны - и, как видишь, он так здесь и остался.
The Breaking Point#178.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#179.src: Just another remnant of our past mistakes, I suppose...
The Breaking Point#179.dst: Ещё один след наших прошлых ошибок, полагаю…
The Breaking Point#179.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#180.src: Ahem. In any case- as I said, True Ice is impossible to break through, even with the most scorching flames.
The Breaking Point#180.dst: Кхм. В общем - как я сказал, True Ice не пробить, даже самым жарким пламенем.
The Breaking Point#180.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#181.src: I... I suppose that a dragon's breath might be able to melt it. That logic does make sense.
The Breaking Point#181.dst: Я… Пожалуй, дыхание дракона могло бы его растопить. В этом есть логика.
The Breaking Point#181.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#182.src: We have little knowledge of what dragons were like, though. As they went extinct, that information became... useless. And so, it was lost.
The Breaking Point#182.dst: Но о драконах мы знаем мало. Когда они вымерли, эти знания стали… бесполезны. И потому утрачены.
The Breaking Point#182.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#183.src: If anyone would know more about dragons, it would be the doguns.
The Breaking Point#183.dst: Если кто и знает о драконах больше, то это Dogun.
The Breaking Point#183.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#184.src: But none of that matters. All the dragons are gone, after all. We still have no options.
The Breaking Point#184.dst: Но это неважно. Драконов ведь больше нет. Выхода у нас по-прежнему нет.
The Breaking Point#184.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#185.src: Why, they died out. As Gavellian civilizations grew in size, the ferocity and size of a dragon was simply too much of a threat.
The Breaking Point#185.dst: Как же, вымерли. Когда цивилизации Gavel разрослись, свирепость и размер драконов стали слишком большой угрозой.
The Breaking Point#185.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#186.src: Some were hunted. Some died of starvation. Eggs were taken from nests and shattered over boulders for the birds to feed on.
The Breaking Point#186.dst: Одних истребили. Другие умерли от голода. Яйца забирали из гнёзд и разбивали о валуны на корм птицам.
The Breaking Point#186.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#187.src: Now all that are left are dragonlings - echoes of their once-great ancestors, with barely enough flames to singe your armor.
The Breaking Point#187.dst: Теперь остались лишь дракончики - эхо их великих предков, чьего пламени едва хватит опалить твою броню.
The Breaking Point#187.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#189.src: A living dragon... You've done quite a lot, haven't you? Stopped a war, moved a dragon...
The Breaking Point#189.dst: Живой дракон… Немало за тобой дел, а? Остановить войну, сдвинуть дракона…
The Breaking Point#189.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#190.src: Well... if there is a living dragon at {p}... Then we still have hope! {u}, we must ask for its help.
The Breaking Point#190.dst: Что ж… если в {p} живой дракон… то надежда есть! {u}, мы должны попросить его помощи.
The Breaking Point#190.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#191.src: Let us return to the others. I asked them to wait outside of {p}... perhaps they'll be able to confirm that a dragon's breath would do the job.
The Breaking Point#191.dst: Вернёмся к остальным. Я просил их ждать у {p}… может, они подтвердят, что дыхание дракона справится.
The Breaking Point#191.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#192.src: Indeed. The fire dragons that sided with them during the war. I'm sure you've come across the skeleton just outside Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#192.dst: Именно. Огненные драконы, что сражались на их стороне в войне. Скелет у самых Freezing Heights тебе наверняка попадался?
The Breaking Point#192.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#193.src: Yes, well... the Dwarves needed a counter to the sheer power of a fire dragon in battle, and so they resorted to enslaving dragons and drakes of other elements.
The Breaking Point#193.dst: Да, что ж… дворфам нужно было что-то против мощи огненного дракона в бою, и они стали порабощать драконов иных стихий.
The Breaking Point#193.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#194.src: Like the Ice Drake that created this vault, and encased the Elders in the truest of ice.
The Breaking Point#194.dst: Как тот Ice Drake, что создал это хранилище и заковал старейшин в самый что ни на есть True Ice.
The Breaking Point#194.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#195.src: ... Well, there was this excellent novel of about one of those creatures from the Shiar, who had to travel to the Heights with this ring he had inherited-
The Breaking Point#195.dst: …Ну, был один чудесный роман про такое существо из Shiar, что несло в Heights унаследованное кольцо-
The Breaking Point#195.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#196.src: But I confess, these questions seem almost irrelevant. We have a more pressing issue at hand, {u}.
The Breaking Point#196.dst: Но, признаюсь, вопросы эти сейчас почти неважны. У нас есть дело посрочнее, {u}.
The Breaking Point#196.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#197.src: This ice is harder than obsidian itself. The crystals which form the material are bonded by ancient magic.
The Breaking Point#197.dst: Этот лёд твёрже самого обсидиана. Кристаллы, из которых он состоит, скреплены древней магией.
The Breaking Point#197.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#198.src: Shattering it with such tools isn't an option. Perhaps there is a weapon that could break through, somewhere deep in our armory- after all, this vault had to be carved somehow...
The Breaking Point#198.dst: Разбить его такими инструментами нельзя. Может, в недрах нашего арсенала есть оружие, способное его пробить - хранилище ведь как-то вырезали…
The Breaking Point#198.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#199.src: However, given the circumstances, I don't think we have the time to search for it. Even if we started now, our armory is enormous. It would take weeks to find what we need.
The Breaking Point#199.dst: Но, учитывая обстоятельства, на поиски нет времени. Даже начни мы сейчас - арсенал огромен. Искать нужное пришлось бы неделями.
The Breaking Point#199.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#200.src: The lava of the Heights is nothing more than molten rock. Just a remnant of the shaping of these caverns.
The Breaking Point#200.dst: Лава Heights - всего лишь расплавленный камень. Остаток от формирования этих пещер.
The Breaking Point#200.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#201.src: It's not nearly hot enough to melt True Ice. If it could, the Freezing Heights would have faded long ago.
The Breaking Point#201.dst: Она далеко не так горяча, чтобы растопить True Ice. Иначе Freezing Heights давно бы исчезли.
The Breaking Point#201.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#202.src: My... uhm... green is nice, I suppose? Though perhaps not very Dwarven...
The Breaking Point#202.dst: Мой… э-э… зелёный, наверное, неплох? Хотя, пожалуй, не очень по-дворфски…
The Breaking Point#202.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#203.src: Red, then. Or orange! ...Although my bedsheets are the most wonderful shade of navy blue...
The Breaking Point#203.dst: Тогда красный. Или оранжевый! …Хотя у моих простыней чудесный оттенок тёмно-синего…
The Breaking Point#203.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#204.src: Breakfast... I had some eggs, I suppose. Though, I had no idea that breakfast would be my last, did I..?
The Breaking Point#204.dst: Завтрак… Кажется, я ел яйца. Хотя кто ж знал, что тот завтрак станет последним, а…?
The Breaking Point#204.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#205.src: Hm... Had I known, maybe I would have chosen differently. Maybe I would have-... nevermind.
The Breaking Point#205.dst: Хм… Знай я заранее, может, выбрал бы иначе. Может, я бы-… неважно.
The Breaking Point#205.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#206.src: Regroup at outside {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out how to free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#206.dst: Соберись у {p} в [{~}, {~}, -{~}], чтобы решить, как освободить старейшин.

The Breaking Point#207.src: ... so this is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#207.dst: …вот в каком мы положении. Paku, что скажешь? Сработает такой план?
The Breaking Point#207.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#208.src: Hm... You may be correct... Draani. The magic in... a dragon's breath... was very potent. And to think... mighty Ozoth had survived... all these years...
The Breaking Point#208.dst: Хм… Возможно, ты прав… Draani. Магия в… дыхании дракона… была очень сильна. И подумать только… могучая Ozoth… пережила… все эти годы…
The Breaking Point#208.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#209.src: If Ozoth is alive... we must seek her help. If the doguns ask... for her aid, she will... give it.
The Breaking Point#209.dst: Если Ozoth жива… надо просить её помощи. Если Dogun попросят… она не откажет.
The Breaking Point#209.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#210.src: Well, that's as good a plan as any. {u}, you'll travel to seek this dragon's counsel, along with... Ineos, was it? Good luck.
The Breaking Point#210.dst: Что ж, план не хуже любого другого. {u}, ты отправишься за советом к этому дракону вместе с… Ineos, верно? Удачи.
The Breaking Point#210.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#211.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I will put the coordinates... in your Quest Book.
The Breaking Point#211.dst: Лучше… идти торговым туннелем… {u}. Я запишу координаты… в твою книгу заданий.
The Breaking Point#211.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#212.src: Use the {p} trading tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to travel to {p}.

The Breaking Point#213.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] in an attempt to speak with her.
The Breaking Point#213.dst: Отправляйся в {p} в [{~}, {~}, -{~}] и попытайся поговорить с ней.

The Breaking Point#214.src: Ah... it is... good to... see you. We must... proceed to Ozoth... with all haste.
The Breaking Point#214.dst: А… рад… видеть тебя. Нужно… как можно скорее… идти к Ozoth.
The Breaking Point#214.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#215.src: Ozoth the Dragon... Endless Kindler... we have come... to ask for your aid.
The Breaking Point#215.dst: Дракон Ozoth… Вечная Разжигательница… мы пришли… просить твоей помощи.
The Breaking Point#215.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#217.src: We are searching... for a way... to melt the truest... of ice. The fate... of Gavel... hangs in the balance.
The Breaking Point#217.dst: Мы ищем… способ… растопить самый истинный… лёд. Судьба… Gavel… висит на волоске.
The Breaking Point#217.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#218.src: Doguns... and Dragons... our fates have been entwined... for centuries. We call on you now... Endless Kindler... to save this province.
The Breaking Point#218.dst: Dogun… и драконы… наши судьбы сплетены… веками. Мы взываем к тебе… Вечная Разжигательница… спаси эту провинцию.
The Breaking Point#218.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#220.src: I... see. ... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#220.dst: Я… понял. …Ozoth говорит… что Вечное пламя… освободит старейшин.
The Breaking Point#220.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#222.src: The Endless Kindler... is willing to part... with hers. You must... retrieve it... from her stomach.
The Breaking Point#222.dst: Вечная Разжигательница… готова расстаться… со своим. Тебе нужно… достать его… из её желудка.
The Breaking Point#222.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#224.src: I would advise you... not to think... too much about this. When... you are ready... enter Ozoth's mouth and retrieve... the flame.
The Breaking Point#224.dst: Советую… не думать… об этом слишком много. Как… соберёшься… войди в пасть Ozoth и забери… пламя.
The Breaking Point#224.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#225.src: Descend into Ozoth's belly to retrieve an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#225.dst: Спустись в брюхо Ozoth и добудь Вечное пламя.

The Breaking Point#226.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] with an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#226.dst: Отправляйся с Вечным пламенем в {p} в [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Breaking Point#227.src: {u}! Have you retrieved... the Eternal Flame?
The Breaking Point#227.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#228.src: Excellent. Endless Kindler... thank you... for your sacrifice. I will ensure... that your flame... is returned to you.
The Breaking Point#228.dst: Прекрасно. Вечная Разжигательница… спасибо… за твою жертву. Я прослежу… чтобы твоё пламя… вернулось к тебе.
The Breaking Point#228.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#230.src: Ozoth apologises... if it was a bit hot... in there.
The Breaking Point#230.dst: Ozoth извиняется… если там… было жарковато.
The Breaking Point#230.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#231.src: Now, {u}... I was never the best... at the ancient magic... but I hope I have enough skill... to take us the short route back...
The Breaking Point#231.dst: Итак, {u}… я никогда не был силён… в древней магии… но надеюсь, мне хватит умения… вернуть нас коротким путём…
The Breaking Point#231.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#232.src: You have returned! Is there news from {p}? Did the dragon offer aid?
The Breaking Point#232.dst: Вы вернулись! Есть вести из {p}? Дракон согласился помочь?
The Breaking Point#232.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#233.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Eternal Flame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#233.dst: Да… Ozoth принесла великую жертву… ради провинции… но у нас есть Вечное пламя… чтобы растопить лёд.
The Breaking Point#233.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#234.src: Well done... both of you. I will ensure... that the doguns thank her... properly. The dwarves would do well... to do the same.
The Breaking Point#234.dst: Молодцы… вы оба. Я прослежу… чтобы Dogun как следует… её отблагодарили. Дворфам стоило бы… сделать то же.
The Breaking Point#234.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#235.src: Yes, yes, but there's no time to worry about that now. Quick, let's get back to the-
The Breaking Point#235.dst: Да, да, но сейчас не до того. Скорее, возвращаемся к-
The Breaking Point#235.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#236.src: Be wary... of the Elders... Draani. It is unlikely they will react well... after their imprisonment. It is vital... you explain the situation... to them.
The Breaking Point#236.dst: Остерегайся… старейшин… Draani. После заточения… вряд ли они встретят тебя добром. Важно… объяснить им… положение дел.
The Breaking Point#236.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#237.src: I would join you... both... but the ice is inhospitable... to my kind. I wish the both of you... the best of luck.
The Breaking Point#237.dst: Я пошёл бы… с вами… но лёд враждебен… моему роду. Желаю вам обоим… удачи.
The Breaking Point#237.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#238.src: ...right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#238.dst: …ладно. Да. Что ж, этого не избежать. Идём, {u}. Надо разморозить старейшин и заставить их нас выслушать. Бери пламя, встретимся у хранилища.
The Breaking Point#238.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#239.src: Return to the Dogun Vault at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to free the Dogun Elders.
The Breaking Point#239.dst: Вернись в хранилище Dogun в [{~}, {~}, -{~}] и освободи старейшин Dogun.

The Breaking Point#240.src: Well then, what are we waiting for! Let's free these elders, shall we?
The Breaking Point#240.dst: Ну, чего же мы ждём! Освободим этих старейшин, а?
The Breaking Point#240.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#241.src: Just bring the Everflame to each of the cells, and melt through that True Ice.
The Breaking Point#241.dst: Просто поднеси Вечное пламя к каждой камере и растопи True Ice.
The Breaking Point#241.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#242.src: Excellent! We've done it! Now we just need to explain the situation-...
The Breaking Point#242.dst: Превосходно! Получилось! Теперь осталось объяснить положение-…
The Breaking Point#242.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#244.src: ...Ah. I suppose I did not... think this through. Ehm. Elders, I must apo-
The Breaking Point#244.dst: …Ах. Похоже, я не… продумал это. Кхм. Старейшины, я должен изви-
The Breaking Point#244.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#245.src: Dwarf... Hm. The crimes... of your ancestors... must be repaid.
The Breaking Point#245.dst: Дворф… Хм. За преступления… твоих предков… придётся расплатиться.
The Breaking Point#245.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#246.src: However. We have... heard you speak. We have... learned of... the Protector's state.
The Breaking Point#246.dst: Однако. Мы… слышали ваши речи. Мы… узнали… о состоянии Защитника.
The Breaking Point#246.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#247.src: We will... settle your debt... later. This situation... is a more pressing... concern. The Protector... must be calmed.
The Breaking Point#247.dst: Твой долг… мы взыщем… позже. Нынешнее положение… куда более… насущно. Защитника… надо успокоить.
The Breaking Point#247.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#248.src: ...Yes. You. Human. That was... dragonfire... was it not?
The Breaking Point#248.dst: …Да. Ты. Человек. Это было… драконье пламя… не так ли?
The Breaking Point#248.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#249.src: Then allow me... to borrow it. Its strength... will allow us... to restore ours. Now... Who now holds... the title... of Chieftain?
The Breaking Point#249.dst: Тогда позволь мне… его одолжить. Его сила… поможет нам… вернуть свою. А теперь… Кто ныне носит… титул… вождя?
The Breaking Point#249.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#250.src: A-ah! Paku is now the Dogun Chieftain. He would be at... At Taloka.
The Breaking Point#250.dst: А-а! Вождь Dogun теперь Paku. Он должен быть… В Taloka.
The Breaking Point#250.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#251.src: Very well... We shall travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#251.dst: Хорошо… Мы отправимся… сквозь пламя… и сквозь камень…
The Breaking Point#251.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#252.src: ...The Elders... after all this time... to see you, again... in the flesh...
The Breaking Point#252.dst: …Старейшины… спустя столько времени… снова видеть вас… воочию…
The Breaking Point#252.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#253.src: Greetings, Paku. We have much... to discuss. But first... we must travel... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#253.dst: Приветствую, Paku. Нам многое… нужно обсудить. Но сперва… мы должны отправиться… к Защитнику.
The Breaking Point#253.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#254.src: Join us... Ineos and Paku. There is... very little time... to waste.
The Breaking Point#254.dst: Идёмте с нами… Ineos и Paku. Времени… терять… нельзя.
The Breaking Point#254.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#255.src: Now, let us travel... (The following part of the line is High Gavellian) Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#255.dst: А теперь в путь… (Далее - на высоком наречии Gavel) Сквозь пламя… и сквозь камень…
The Breaking Point#255.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#256.src: Korzim... my son... join us. The Elders must see... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#256.dst: Korzim… сын мой… идём с нами. Старейшинам нужно… к Защитнику.
The Breaking Point#256.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#257.src: Iscor... Astal... Desint... it has been... too long. I will come.
The Breaking Point#257.dst: Iscor… Astal… Desint… прошло… так много времени. Я пойду.
The Breaking Point#257.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#258.src: Earth and flame... fire and stone... transport us through your form! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#258.dst: Земля и пламя… огонь и камень… перенесите нас сквозь себя! (на высоком наречии Gavel)
The Breaking Point#258.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#260.src: There's no time! I can feel the damned ground cracking beneath my feet, we have to turn to the final option. We've had demolition mages on standby the past few days, our only choice is to-
The Breaking Point#260.dst: Некогда! Я чувствую, как проклятая земля трескается под ногами, пора к последнему средству. Маги-подрывники уже несколько дней наготове, выбора нет, кроме как-
The Breaking Point#260.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#261.src: Rhay. Elix. My Elders... have been freed. They are here... to help... the Protector.
The Breaking Point#261.dst: Rhay. Elix. Мои старейшины… свободны. Они здесь… чтобы помочь… Защитнику.
The Breaking Point#261.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#262.src: Join us... brave ones. You will see... that your efforts to save this Province... have not been in vain.
The Breaking Point#262.dst: Идёмте с нами… храбрецы. Вы увидите… что ваши старания спасти провинцию… не напрасны.
The Breaking Point#262.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#263.src: Flames of the earth... take us to the Great Protector... to make our plea! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#263.dst: Пламя земли… отнеси нас к Великому Защитнику… дабы вознести мольбу! (на высоком наречии Gavel)
The Breaking Point#263.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#264.src: Travel to the Canyon Colossus at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to calm it.
The Breaking Point#264.dst: Отправляйся к Колоссу Каньона в [{~}, {~}, -{~}] и попытайся его успокоить.

The Breaking Point#266.src: Hmph. Foolish dwarves... This is what has come...of your needless war... You are fortunate...to have freed us now...
The Breaking Point#266.dst: Хм. Глупые дворфы… Вот к чему привела… ваша ненужная война… Вам повезло… освободить нас сейчас…
The Breaking Point#266.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#267.src: Desint... Iscor... I will prepare... the ritual. Defend me... as I do so.
The Breaking Point#267.dst: Desint… Iscor… Я подготовлю… ритуал. Защищайте меня… пока я занят.
The Breaking Point#267.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#268.src: Human. We will pull the Protector... away from the brink. That is all we can do now. All the power... we can muster.
The Breaking Point#268.dst: Человек. Мы оттащим Защитника… от края. Больше мы сейчас ничего не можем. Вся сила… что мы соберём.
The Breaking Point#268.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#269.src: You must enter... these sacred grounds. Battle through it to the end... Knock some sense... into it.
The Breaking Point#269.dst: Тебе нужно войти… в эти священные земли. Пробейся до конца… Вправь ему… мозги.
The Breaking Point#269.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#270.src: Adventurer... We are counting...on you. We will try to...support you however we can.
The Breaking Point#270.dst: Искатель приключений… Мы рассчитываем… на тебя. Мы постараемся… поддержать тебя всем, чем сможем.
The Breaking Point#270.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#271.src: We'll do the best we can out here! I have some ideas already...
The Breaking Point#271.dst: А мы здесь сделаем всё, что сможем! У меня уже есть пара идей…
The Breaking Point#271.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#272.src: Rhay, this isn't the time. Human. We have your back. You can do this.
The Breaking Point#272.dst: Rhay, сейчас не время. Человек. Мы вас прикроем. Вы справитесь.
The Breaking Point#272.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#273.src: You have faced...worse odds before...have you not? You will face them...again.
The Breaking Point#273.dst: Бывало ведь… и хуже… не так ли? Справишься… и сейчас.
The Breaking Point#273.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#274.src: It is done. Desint... Iscor... Take your postions. We must... hold it back.
The Breaking Point#274.dst: Готово. Desint… Iscor… По местам. Мы должны… сдержать его.
The Breaking Point#274.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#275.src: Great Protector, lord of stone, hear our burning call. Your fury clouds your vision, your anger burns and twists our home. (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#275.dst: Великий Защитник, владыка камня, услышь наш пылающий зов. Гнев застит тебе взор, ярость жжёт и корёжит наш дом. (на высоком наречии Gavel)
The Breaking Point#275.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#276.src: We, the doguns, who now hold the final flame of a fallen god... We will hold you back. We will keep this land intact! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#276.dst: Мы, Dogun, хранящие последнее пламя павшего бога… Мы сдержим тебя. Мы сохраним эту землю! (на высоком наречии Gavel)
The Breaking Point#276.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#277.src: We will... hold it from here... human. Now... go! We will not... be able to hold it... for long...
The Breaking Point#277.dst: Мы… сдержим его… отсюда… человек. А теперь… иди! Нам не удержать его… надолго…
The Breaking Point#277.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#278.src: This crystal...will let you harness...our flame. Use it...to break through...its defenses.
The Breaking Point#278.dst: Этот кристалл… позволит тебе… обуздать наше пламя. Пробей им… его защиту.
The Breaking Point#278.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#279.src: ... Before you go. I will offer you... these powerful relics. Our people... have held them for... longer than I have lived. They may... help you on your quest.
The Breaking Point#279.dst: … Прежде чем уйдёшь. Я дам тебе… эти могучие реликвии. Наш народ… хранил их… дольше, чем я живу. Может… они помогут тебе в пути.
The Breaking Point#279.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#280.src: I cannot give you something as unique as what Paku has offered, but I can still lend you a sum from our treasury. Use it as you must, so long as you can calm that thing. Good luck.
The Breaking Point#280.dst: Я не могу дать тебе ничего столь же особенного, как дар Paku, но могу выделить сумму из казны. Трать как нужно, лишь бы усмирить эту тварь. Удачи.
The Breaking Point#280.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#000~1.src: Hey, keep up! We need to get this part into the machine as quickly as we can!
The Breaking Point#000~1.dst: Эй, не отставай! Нужно как можно быстрее поставить деталь в машину!

The Breaking Point#001~1.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to Kandon Beda with that capacitor as quick as possible.
The Breaking Point#001~1.dst: Отличная работа! Я как можно скорее доставлю нас с конденсатором обратно в Kandon Beda.

The Breaking Point#002~1.src: I... see. {u}... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#002~1.dst: Я… понял. {u}… Ozoth говорит… что Вечное пламя… освободит старейшин.

similar.text: I... see. ... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.

The Breaking Point#003~1.src: You need to get onto the path up to {p}. There should be signposts outside of {p}...
The Breaking Point#003~1.dst: Выйди на тропу к {p}. У {p} должны быть указатели…

The Breaking Point#039~1.src: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, for obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
The Breaking Point#039~1.dst: Да, да. Не обращай внимания, я немного на взводе, по… ну, по понятным причинам. Запрыгивай.
The Breaking Point#039~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#042~1.src: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all of our problems here at {p}.
The Breaking Point#042~1.dst: Вот он! Сам Колосс каньона. Источник всех наших бед здесь, в {p}.
The Breaking Point#042~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#053~1.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try and keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#053~1.dst: Эта штука древняя, и мы не знаем, как она работает. Всё, что можем, - не дать ей дойти до предела и не дать каньону повторить судьбу {p}.
The Breaking Point#053~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#056~1.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified the Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#056~1.dst: Совет согласился, и мы стали проектировать машину, способную повторить магию Dogun, что усмирила Колосса давным-давно.
The Breaking Point#056~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#072~1.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maintenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#072~1.dst: Так, ладно, к вопросу - что вы двое тут уже делаете? До следующего планового обслуживания ещё пара дней, разве нет?
The Breaking Point#072~1.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#077~1.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an unexpected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#077~1.dst: Точно! Точно. Отвлёкся… Э, у нас проблема в {p}. Случилось неожиданное сейсмическое событие, и устройство сильно повреждено.
The Breaking Point#077~1.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#120~1.src: It looks like Ozoth's body is trying to prevent you from getting the Everflame!
The Breaking Point#120~1.dst: Похоже, тело Ozoth пытается помешать тебе забрать Вечное пламя!

The Breaking Point#147~1.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed brethren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#147~1.dst: Да. Мы… усердно трудились… эти недели. Taloka скоро… снова поднимется. И многие… из наших запечатанных братьев… вернулись к жизни.
The Breaking Point#147~1.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#149~1.src: You use the grappling hook to swing back to the King in a dazzling feat of trapeze consisting of mid-air flips and acrobatic flourishes.
The Breaking Point#149~1.dst: С помощью крюка-кошки ты ослепительно перелетаешь обратно к Королю - с сальто в воздухе и акробатическими трюками.

The Breaking Point#152~1.src: The situation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#152~1.dst: Положение… отчаянное. Великий Защитник… слишком долго… был один. Нам нужна… мудрость… старейшин. Знаешь… где их запечатали?
The Breaking Point#152~1.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#173~1.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#173~1.dst: Хм. Это… не сработало. Магия древняя, а я так и не выучил её как следует… Ладно. Есть другие способы.
The Breaking Point#173~1.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174~1.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other end of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#174~1.dst: Если память не подводит, на той стороне пропасти должен быть ручной рычаг.
The Breaking Point#174~1.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#226~1.src: ... so that is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#226~1.dst: …вот в каком мы положении. Paku, что скажешь? Такой план сработает?
The Breaking Point#226~1.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#254~1.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Everflame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#254~1.dst: Да… Ozoth принесла великую жертву… ради провинции… но у нас есть Вечное пламя… чтобы растопить лёд.
The Breaking Point#254~1.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#260~1.src: ... right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#260~1.dst: …ладно. Да. Что ж, от этого не уйти. Идём, {u}. Нужно разморозить старейшин и заставить их выслушать. Бери пламя, встретимся в Хранилище.
The Breaking Point#260~1.speaker: King Draani

The Canary Calls#000.src: Find out what's happening at the {p} coal mine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#000.dst: Выясни, что творится в угольной шахте {p} на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#001.src: Phew... Everyone make it out alright? That was...one hell of a sprint. I'm absolutely knackered.
The Canary Calls#001.dst: Фух… Все выбрались целы? Ну и забег был… Я совсем выдохся.
The Canary Calls#001.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#002.src: I'm not sure, mate. I left a bunch of my stuff down there. Who knows if I'll get it back.
The Canary Calls#002.dst: Не знаю, приятель. Я там кучу вещей оставил. Кто знает, верну ли.
The Canary Calls#002.speaker: Micho

The Canary Calls#003.src: Forget about that, what are we gonna tell the chief? That chopsy old fool is gonna kill us if he sees us not working.
The Canary Calls#003.dst: Забудь. Что скажем шефу? Старый брехун нас прибьёт, если увидит, что мы не работаем.
The Canary Calls#003.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#004.src: Oi, you! Listen, there was some kind of explosion down in the mines. We're not sure what it is or where it came from, but it surely didn't sound good.
The Canary Calls#004.dst: Эй, ты! Слушай, внизу в шахте что-то взорвалось. Не знаем, что это и откуда, но звучало паршиво.
The Canary Calls#004.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#005.src: The four of us were the only blokes down in the mines, so everyone should be out safely. But I reckon we can't go back if this issue isn't resolved.
The Canary Calls#005.dst: Внизу были только мы вчетвером, так что все вышли целыми. Но пока это не уладят, обратно нам нельзя.
The Canary Calls#005.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#006.src: You must go to the chief and tell him about the situation. Head down this mineshaft and turn left, and he should be there.
The Canary Calls#006.dst: Иди к шефу и расскажи, что случилось. Спустись по этому стволу и сверни налево - он там.
The Canary Calls#006.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#007.src: Just, uh... Make sure not to mention us by name. Now, if you'll excuse us, we'll...be on our way.
The Canary Calls#007.dst: Только, э… Не называй наши имена. А теперь, извини, мы… пойдём.
The Canary Calls#007.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#008.src: Turn left from the mine's entrance and speak to the chief at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#008.dst: Сверни налево от входа в шахту и поговори с шефом на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#009.src: That's right, keep it moving! The whole of {p} is going to run out of coal at this pace!
The Canary Calls#009.dst: Вот так, не стоять! С таким темпом у всего {p} кончится уголь!
The Canary Calls#009.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#010.src: Eh? What do you want? Only registered miners are allowed beyond this point. Speak up or get off the premises.
The Canary Calls#010.dst: А? Чего надо? Дальше только зарегистрированным шахтёрам. Говори или проваливай.
The Canary Calls#010.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#011.src: ...An explosion? In the mines? Just now?
The Canary Calls#011.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#012.src: EMERGENCY BREAK TIME, YOU GERBILS! EVERYONE COME AND MEET ME BY THE ENTRANCE! NOW!!!
The Canary Calls#012.dst: ЭКСТРЕННЫЙ ПЕРЕРЫВ, ПЕСЧАНКИ! ВСЕ КО МНЕ, К ВХОДУ! ЖИВО!!!
The Canary Calls#012.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#013.src: Alright, you lot better listen bloody carefully. An explosion has been reported in the mines. You all know what that means, yes?
The Canary Calls#013.dst: Так, слушайте, чёрт возьми, внимательно. В шахте был взрыв. Все знаете, что это значит, да?
The Canary Calls#013.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#018.src: No, you bunch of ingrates! One of you needs to take the ol' canary down to the mines and see whatever the hell's going on.
The Canary Calls#018.dst: Нет, неблагодарные! Один из вас возьмёт старушку-канарейку в шахту и глянет, что там, чёрт побери, творится.
The Canary Calls#018.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#019.src: Now, which one of you blokes would be willing to-
The Canary Calls#019.dst: Итак, кто из вас, ребята, готов-
The Canary Calls#019.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#021.src: Right then. I guess that leaves you, young lad. What do you say? Want a job?
The Canary Calls#021.dst: Ну ладно. Значит, остаёшься ты, парень. Что скажешь? Нужна работа?
The Canary Calls#021.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#022.src: Very good! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#022.dst: Отлично! Пойдём, познакомлю тебя с нашим пернатым талисманом.
The Canary Calls#022.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#023.src: You sure? I'll pay a lot, and it won't be dangerous. Even if it is, you've got all that armor on you!
The Canary Calls#023.dst: Точно? Заплачу много, и это не опасно. А если и опасно - на тебе вон сколько брони!
The Canary Calls#023.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#024.src: That's the spirit! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#024.dst: Вот это дух! Пойдём, познакомлю тебя с нашим пернатым талисманом.
The Canary Calls#024.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#025.src: You'll get a bloody mountain of emeralds, god damn it! This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Do you want it or not?
The Canary Calls#025.dst: Получишь целую гору изумрудов, чёрт возьми! Такой шанс раз в жизни! Берёшь или нет?
The Canary Calls#025.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#026.src: Good. Now, hurry up and follow me.
The Canary Calls#026.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#027.src: You know what? This is ridiculous. The whole of {p} is at danger, and you're playing games with ME?! I know you can do it. Follow me. Now.
The Canary Calls#027.dst: Знаешь что? Это смешно. Весь {p} в опасности, а ты со МНОЙ в игры играешь?! Я знаю, ты справишься. За мной. Живо.
The Canary Calls#027.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#028.src: Scared speechless, eh? Don't worry, it'll be an easy job. Come on, follow me to the canary's cage.
The Canary Calls#028.dst: Что, от страха язык отнялся? Не бойся, работа лёгкая. Пошли к клетке канарейки.
The Canary Calls#028.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#029.src: Meet our canary! She's such a beaut.
The Canary Calls#029.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#030.src: You see, whenever we hear news of an explosion we always bring our canary with us to check it out. They can detect potential gases much earlier than we can.
The Canary Calls#030.dst: Видишь ли, как услышим про взрыв, всегда берём канарейку проверить. Они чуют газы куда раньше нас.
The Canary Calls#030.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#031.src: Let me just get the key and-
The Canary Calls#031.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#032.src: WAIT, WHAT? WHERE'S THE BLOODY KEY? WHICH ONE OF YOUR LOT IS RESPONSIBLE?! I SWEAR I'M GONNA...
The Canary Calls#032.dst: СТОП, ЧТО? ГДЕ ЧЁРТОВ КЛЮЧ? КТО ИЗ ВАС В ОТВЕТЕ?! КЛЯНУСЬ, Я ВАС…
The Canary Calls#032.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#033.src: ...Listen up, lad. Take this toothpick I've been chewing on. I need you to pick the cage's lock. It's a little wet, but it should do the trick. Understood? Good, now hurry up!
The Canary Calls#033.dst: …Слушай, парень. Держи зубочистку, я её жевал. Вскрой ею замок клетки. Она мокровата, но сойдёт. Ясно? Хорошо, давай быстрее!
The Canary Calls#033.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#035.src: Doing just fine, lad. Almost there...
The Canary Calls#035.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#036.src: Little old birdie is getting quite excited! Keep it up.
The Canary Calls#036.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#037.src: Right then, lad! It's time to begin the-
The Canary Calls#037.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#038.src: OW! Bloody hell! Those are some freakishly sharp claws! What are you playing at-
The Canary Calls#038.dst: АЙ! Чёрт! Ну и когти, острые до жути! Ты что творишь-
The Canary Calls#038.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#039.src: Well, I think she likes you, lad. Doesn't like me, apparently.
The Canary Calls#039.dst: Похоже, ты ей нравишься, парень. А я, видать, нет.
The Canary Calls#039.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#040.src: I was going to feed her, but I suppose you can do the honors. Or not, seeing as she's been particularly troublesome...
The Canary Calls#040.dst: Я хотел её покормить, но уступаю эту честь тебе. Или не надо - она сегодня особенно вредная…
The Canary Calls#040.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#041.src: Anyway, do as you please. I'll be waiting by the elevator in the mineshaft. Hurry up, and don't make me wait!
The Canary Calls#041.dst: В общем, как хочешь. Жду у подъёмника в стволе. Поторопись, не заставляй ждать!
The Canary Calls#041.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#042.src: Head to the mine elevator at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#043.src: Right then, lad! I suppose you might want to know more about this job.
The Canary Calls#043.dst: Так, парень! Небось хочешь знать о работе побольше.
The Canary Calls#043.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#044.src: As I said before, when unknown explosions occur in the mines, that's usually a sign that something bad happened.
The Canary Calls#044.dst: Как я говорил, если в шахте непонятные взрывы, это обычно значит, что стряслось что-то плохое.
The Canary Calls#044.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#045.src: Most of the time, an awfully putrid gas appears. This is where our canary comes in. Once she verifies that a gas is present, we decide whether or not to temporarily close the mine.
The Canary Calls#045.dst: Чаще всего появляется жутко вонючий газ. Тут-то и нужна канарейка. Если она подтвердит газ, решаем, закрывать ли шахту на время.
The Canary Calls#045.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#046.src: I presume you met Daffyd and his group, correct? Thankfully, they were the only ones down in the mines.
The Canary Calls#046.dst: Daffyd и его ребята тебе уже попадались, так? К счастью, внизу были только они.
The Canary Calls#046.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#047.src: ...Wait, where the hell even are they? Did I not tell them to...
The Canary Calls#047.dst: …Стоп, а где они вообще? Я же велел им…
The Canary Calls#047.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#048.src: Eh, doesn't matter. Lad, point is, I want you to check whether the gas is still there, if at all.
The Canary Calls#048.dst: Э, неважно. Суть, парень: проверь, остался ли газ, если он вообще был.
The Canary Calls#048.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#049.src: We'll use the elevator behind me to get down to the mines. Just let me pull this here lever to activate it...
The Canary Calls#049.dst: Спустимся в шахту на подъёмнике за мной. Сейчас дёрну рычаг, чтобы запустить…
The Canary Calls#049.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#050.src: ...WHY ISN'T THIS BLOODY CONTRAPTION WORKING??! WORK, WORK, GOD DAMN IT!!
The Canary Calls#050.dst: …ПОЧЕМУ ЭТА ЧЁРТОВА ШТУКОВИНА НЕ РАБОТАЕТ??! РАБОТАЙ, РАБОТАЙ, ЧЁРТ ТЕБЯ ДЕРИ!!
The Canary Calls#050.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#051.src: Must've been Daffyd and his group... No worries, lad. I've got, uh... a last resort, so to speak.
The Canary Calls#051.dst: Точно Daffyd с дружками… Не бойся, парень. У меня есть, э… так сказать, крайнее средство.
The Canary Calls#051.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#052.src: You'll need to ride a minecart down into the mines. Thing is, we haven't used them to transport people in...years.
The Canary Calls#052.dst: Спустишься в шахту на вагонетке. Только вот людей мы на них не возили уже… годами.
The Canary Calls#052.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#053.src: Why? Erm, well... See for yourself.
The Canary Calls#053.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#054.src: Our transporter minecarts are manual. Miners around here prefer automatic.
The Canary Calls#054.dst: Вагонетки у нас с ручной коробкой. А шахтёры тут любят автомат.
The Canary Calls#054.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#055.src: For you, it should be no issue controlling it. There's instructions attached to the gear stick.
The Canary Calls#055.dst: Для тебя управлять ею не проблема. На рычаге передач есть инструкция.
The Canary Calls#055.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#056.src: Now then, go into the mineshaft, following the rails behind me. You'll be able to summon a minecart there.
The Canary Calls#056.dst: Итак, иди в ствол вдоль рельсов за мной. Там можно вызвать вагонетку.
The Canary Calls#056.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#057.src: Use the rails to get to the gas leakage.
The Canary Calls#057.dst: Доберись по рельсам до утечки газа.

The Canary Calls#058.src: Follow the rail tracks and find a way to escape the mine
The Canary Calls#058.dst: Следуй по рельсам и найди выход из шахты

The Canary Calls#059.src: Continue further in the mine to find a way out.
The Canary Calls#059.dst: Иди вглубь шахты, чтобы найти выход.

The Canary Calls#062.src: I am but a figment of your imagination. To you, I am not real.
The Canary Calls#062.dst: Я лишь плод твоего воображения. Для тебя я не настоящая.
The Canary Calls#062.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#063.src: The mysterious force that brought death upon me... It changed me.
The Canary Calls#063.dst: Таинственная сила, что принесла мне смерть… Она изменила меня.
The Canary Calls#063.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#064.src: So too will it change you. I will make that happen. Just for you.
The Canary Calls#064.dst: Изменит и тебя. Я об этом позабочусь. Только для тебя.
The Canary Calls#064.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#065.src: No need to thank me. It is the least I can do.
The Canary Calls#065.dst: Не благодари. Это меньшее, что я могу сделать.
The Canary Calls#065.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#066.src: Moments like these are cherished. Savor the moment with me. Would you like to die with me?
The Canary Calls#066.dst: Такие мгновения бесценны. Насладись им со мной. Хочешь умереть вместе со мной?
The Canary Calls#066.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#067.src: I see. So you want to make this an unforgettable experience. I appreciate the thoughtfulness.
The Canary Calls#067.dst: Понятно. Хочешь сделать это незабываемым. Ценю такую заботу.
The Canary Calls#067.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#069.src: I was hoping we could stay for a little longer. If that is your choice, then so be it.
The Canary Calls#069.dst: Я надеялась, мы побудем тут ещё немного. Раз таков твой выбор - пусть так.
The Canary Calls#069.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#070.src: See you on the other side.
The Canary Calls#070.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#071.src: I would be more than glad to. Sit back and relax.
The Canary Calls#071.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#073.src: Mine could have been better. Cramped up in a cage all day, then suddenly witnessing my death in front of an incompetent human.
The Canary Calls#073.dst: Мой мог быть и лучше. Весь день в тесной клетке, а потом внезапно смерть на глазах у никчёмного человека.
The Canary Calls#073.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#074.src: You couldn't even save me. How pathetic.
The Canary Calls#074.dst: Даже спасти меня не вышло. Жалко.
The Canary Calls#074.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#075.src: So, anyway, do you come here often?
The Canary Calls#075.dst: Ну так что, часто здесь бываешь?
The Canary Calls#075.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#076.src: Oh, wait. This is your first time. As well as your last time. That's very poetic. Do you want to become a poet?
The Canary Calls#076.dst: Ой, погоди. Ты здесь впервые. И в последний раз. Как поэтично. Хочешь стать поэтом?
The Canary Calls#076.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#077.src: I know a good poem. Want to hear it?
The Canary Calls#077.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#085.src: You will lose a lot of things,
The Canary Calls#085.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#100.src: The most average Joe I've seen,
The Canary Calls#100.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#102.src: How was that? It was beautiful, wasn't it?
The Canary Calls#102.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#103.src: Silence is bliss. You must not have very many friends.
The Canary Calls#103.dst: Молчание - золото. Друзей у тебя, видно, немного.
The Canary Calls#103.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#104.src: That's okay. I am your friend. Am I your friend? Please say yes. I'm very lonely.
The Canary Calls#104.dst: Ничего. Я твой друг. Я ведь твой друг? Скажи «да». Мне так одиноко.
The Canary Calls#104.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#105.src: I had friends too, once. They were all taken by a bunch of selfish coal miners. Then died to their incompetence.
The Canary Calls#105.dst: У меня тоже были друзья. Их всех забрали эгоистичные угольщики. И они погибли из-за их никчёмности.
The Canary Calls#105.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#106.src: But you are different. You are not like the others. I like you. I love you. I love you so much.
The Canary Calls#106.dst: Но с тобой иначе. Ты не как все. Ты мне нравишься. Я люблю тебя. Очень-очень люблю.
The Canary Calls#106.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#121.src: I will give you another chance to redeem yourself.
The Canary Calls#121.dst: Дам тебе ещё шанс искупить вину.
The Canary Calls#121.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#122.src: So kindly, I will tell you again.
The Canary Calls#122.dst: Так уж и быть, повторю по доброте.
The Canary Calls#122.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#124.src: Let's do a little warm-up, shall we?
The Canary Calls#124.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#125.src: Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The '.
The Canary Calls#125.dst: Понравилась дискотека? Движения такие ужасные, что назову их «Танец ».
The Canary Calls#125.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#126.src: Let's do something I like to call, 'The Canary'.
The Canary Calls#126.dst: Сыграем в то, что я зову «Канарейка».
The Canary Calls#126.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#127.src: Hands off those, if you would be so kind.
The Canary Calls#127.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#129.src: It fẽ̵̻̗̤̠̦͋ͯlt nice the fi̶̘͇͓̮̙̲̯ͮͅrst time, but no̠̪͓̙͚̻ͮ̕w it's...diffẽ̵̻̗̤̠̦͋ͯrent.
The Canary Calls#129.dst: В п-первый раз было приятно, но т-теперь… всё иначе.
The Canary Calls#129.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#131.dst: Ладно, к-кто вообще их с-сюда п-поставил?
The Canary Calls#131.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#132.dst: Я уже м-мертва, к-как это в-вообще в-возможно?
The Canary Calls#132.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#134.src: Indeed, you are the one who can destroy the Colossus. (In High Gavellian)
The Canary Calls#134.dst: Да, ты тот, кто может уничтожить Колосса. (на высоком наречии Gavel)
The Canary Calls#134.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#138.src: You are about to enter the cruel, real world.
The Canary Calls#138.dst: Скоро ты войдёшь в жестокий реальный мир.
The Canary Calls#138.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#139.src: Kill me now, so we can spend our final moments together in bliss.
The Canary Calls#139.dst: Убей меня сейчас, и мы проведём последние мгновения в блаженстве.
The Canary Calls#139.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#140.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#140.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#143.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#143.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#145.src: Kill me now or you'll live to regret it.
The Canary Calls#145.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#146.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#146.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#148.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy {p}.
The Canary Calls#148.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#149.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#149.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#151.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy Gavel.
The Canary Calls#151.dst: Убей меня, не то уничтожу Gavel.
The Canary Calls#151.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#152.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#152.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#154.src: Kill me now or I'll ruin every single province.
The Canary Calls#154.dst: Убей меня, не то погублю все провинции до одной.
The Canary Calls#154.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#155.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#155.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#157.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy the world.
The Canary Calls#157.dst: Убей меня, не то уничтожу мир.
The Canary Calls#157.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#158.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#158.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#160.src: Okay so you don't care about the world. In that case, kill me now or I'll kill your friends.
The Canary Calls#160.dst: Ладно, на мир тебе плевать. Тогда убей меня сейчас, не то я убью твоих друзей.
The Canary Calls#160.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#161.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#161.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#163.src: Kill me now or I'll kill everyone in {Your Guild}.
The Canary Calls#163.dst: Убей меня, не то я убью всех в {Your Guild}.
The Canary Calls#163.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#164.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#164.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#166.src: Kill me now or I'll do LITERALLY ANYTHING!
The Canary Calls#166.dst: Убей меня, не то я сделаю БУКВАЛЬНО ЧТО УГОДНО!
The Canary Calls#166.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#167.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#167.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#169.src: No no. No no no no no. No. It's too late.
The Canary Calls#169.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#170.src: I just wanted to play again. Oh well.
The Canary Calls#170.dst: Я лишь хотела ещё поиграть. Ну что ж.
The Canary Calls#170.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#171.src: At least I'll be in your memories. Forever. And ever.
The Canary Calls#171.dst: Зато я останусь в твоей памяти. Навсегда. Во веки веков.
The Canary Calls#171.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#174.src: Keep performing CPR, they're almost awake!
The Canary Calls#174.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#175.src: No way! I actually did it! I saved their life!
The Canary Calls#175.dst: Не может быть! Получилось! Я спас жизнь!
The Canary Calls#175.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#176.src: We better get a raise for this!
The Canary Calls#176.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#177.src: What the?! Who the hell let you in my house?
The Canary Calls#177.dst: Какого?! Кто пустил вас в мой дом?
The Canary Calls#177.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#179.src: No, you can't. Get outta here before I start lowering your salary.
The Canary Calls#179.dst: Нет, не объяснишь. Проваливай, пока зарплату не урезал.
The Canary Calls#179.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#182.src: Well then, lad! Despite their incompetence, they still managed to save your skin.
The Canary Calls#182.dst: Ну что ж, парень! Хоть они и бестолочи, а шкуру твою спасли.
The Canary Calls#182.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#183.src: Come speak to me for a quick debriefing.
The Canary Calls#183.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#185.src: I sent my miners down to save you as soon as we felt that earthquake. It was so strong that I genuinely thought the world was ending.
The Canary Calls#185.dst: Как только тряхнуло, я сразу послал шахтёров тебя спасать. Так сильно, что я уж решил - конец света.
The Canary Calls#185.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#186.src: I'm jolly sorry for forcing you to take on this job. This whole situation was completely unexpected.
The Canary Calls#186.dst: Страшно жаль, что заставил тебя взяться за эту работу. Такого никто не ожидал.
The Canary Calls#186.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#187.src: Typically, gases are cleared up almost instantly. This time, however, it seemed to have been a lot more potent... But how?
The Canary Calls#187.dst: Обычно газы рассеиваются почти сразу. Но в этот раз он, похоже, был куда сильнее… Но почему?
The Canary Calls#187.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#188.src: ...{p}. It stirs once more. That thing... It has already caused too much hardship for this area to handle.
The Canary Calls#188.dst: …{p}. Он снова шевелится. Эта штука… Она уже принесла краю больше бед, чем он может вынести.
The Canary Calls#188.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#189.src: It must be destroyed, once and for all. How will that happen, I do not know. But you...
The Canary Calls#189.dst: Её нужно уничтожить раз и навсегда. Как - не знаю. Но ты…
The Canary Calls#189.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#190.src: ...No, it's nothing. Until that thing is dealt with, deeper parts of this mine must be closed down. The supply of coal will decrease, but it must be done.
The Canary Calls#190.dst: …Нет, ничего. Пока с этой штукой не разберутся, глубокие участки шахты закроем. Угля станет меньше, но так надо.
The Canary Calls#190.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#191.src: Tell you what, lad! I'll give you, and only you, permission to access parts of the mine, right where we mine our world-famous {p} coal.
The Canary Calls#191.dst: Вот что, парень! Даю тебе, и только тебе, доступ в часть шахты, где добывают наш знаменитый уголь {p}.
The Canary Calls#191.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#192.src: Consider yourself a part-time {p} coal miner. You've earned it, lad.
The Canary Calls#192.dst: Считай себя угольщиком {p} на полставки. Заслужено, парень.
The Canary Calls#192.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#195.src: Is this the height of your skill?
The Canary Calls#195.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#197.src: Are you even playing the game?
The Canary Calls#197.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#198.src: Go ahead. Run right into it.
The Canary Calls#198.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#199.src: Was that you, or will you blame that on lag?
The Canary Calls#199.dst: Это твоя ошибка, или свалишь на лаги?
The Canary Calls#199.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#201.src: Even a snail could dodge that.
The Canary Calls#201.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#203.src: Nice going bozo, you fell off.
The Canary Calls#203.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#205.src: Nice try, but that won't work.
The Canary Calls#205.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#206.src: Hey up! Aren't you that Wynn soldier we've heard about? You look proper tough, is all.
The Canary Calls#206.dst: Здорово! Ты ж тот солдат Wynn, о котором все говорят? Вид у тебя больно суровый, вот и всё.
The Canary Calls#206.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#207.src: No, this is definitely them! The name's {u}, right?
The Canary Calls#207.dst: Не, это точно тот самый! Тебя звать {u}, да?
The Canary Calls#207.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#208.src: Woah, this kid's a soldier? I wish I had that kind of job... I'd imagine it's much better than this crap.
The Canary Calls#208.dst: Ого, ребёнок - и солдат? Мне бы такую работу… Уж точно лучше этой дряни.
The Canary Calls#208.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#209.src: Yeah, I really hate this job, man. That and the chief makes me pull my hair out... In fact, I already went bald because of it!
The Canary Calls#209.dst: Ага, ненавижу эту работу, дружище. Она да шеф - хоть волосы рви… Я уже и облысел из-за этого!
The Canary Calls#209.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#210.src: Dude, the chief scares the crap out of me. I'm surprised that I still have this job. Looks like we might lose it if the mines ain't restored fast enough.
The Canary Calls#210.dst: Слушай, шеф меня до смерти пугает. Сам удивляюсь, что меня ещё не выгнали. Если шахту быстро не откроют, работу мы, похоже, потеряем.
The Canary Calls#210.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#211.src: I-I don't want to lose this job, man! I've got a wife and two goldfish!
The Canary Calls#211.dst: Я-я не хочу терять работу, дружище! У меня жена и две золотые рыбки!
The Canary Calls#211.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#212.src: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.
The Canary Calls#212.dst: Спокойно, Ryan. Не потеряем. Мы все заодно. всё уладит.
The Canary Calls#212.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#213.src: Our very lives are in your hands, soldier. Good luck, and be careful. The mines are quite treacherous even for people like you.
The Canary Calls#213.dst: Наши жизни в твоих руках, солдат. Удачи, и береги себя. Шахты коварны даже для таких, как ты.
The Canary Calls#213.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#214.src: We still can't believe we found you. I'm proper shocked.
The Canary Calls#214.dst: Не верится, что мы тебя нашли. Я прям в шоке.
The Canary Calls#214.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#215.src: We had to use that blasted archaic minecart system because the elevator was still busted.
The Canary Calls#215.dst: Пришлось ехать на древних чёртовых вагонетках - подъёмник так и не починили.
The Canary Calls#215.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#216.src: Everyone was exhausted from it. But just when all hope was seemingly lost, we found you laying on the ground.
The Canary Calls#216.dst: Все выбились из сил. Но когда надежды, казалось, не осталось, мы нашли тебя на земле.
The Canary Calls#216.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#217.src: You were violently twitching about, as if you were possessed by something. It was scary.
The Canary Calls#217.dst: Тебя жутко трясло, будто в тебя что-то вселилось. Страшно было.
The Canary Calls#217.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#218.src: Whatever the effects of that gas are, we want absolutely none of it. I'm never stepping foot inside of that bloody mine ever again.
The Canary Calls#218.dst: Что бы там этот газ ни делал, нам такого даром не надо. Больше ни ногой в эту чёртову шахту.
The Canary Calls#218.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#219.src: For the sake of our jobs and {p}, the Colossus must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#219.dst: Ради нашей работы и {p} Colossus нужно остановить.
The Canary Calls#219.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canyon Guides#001.src: Welcome to the Bantisu Temple, wandering human. We aid travelers such as yourself in navigating the capricious canyon walls.
The Canyon Guides#001.dst: Добро пожаловать в храм Bantisu, странник. Мы помогаем путникам вроде вас пройти меж капризных стен каньона.
The Canyon Guides#001.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#002.src: We commune with the wind, and she gives us her sight. Wherever the breeze blows, we may see.
The Canyon Guides#002.dst: Мы говорим с ветром, и он дарит нам зрение. Куда долетает ветерок, туда видим и мы.
The Canyon Guides#002.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#003.src: You appear to be quite strong, and well-kept by your wits. Might we ask you to aid us, then?
The Canyon Guides#003.dst: Вы, похоже, сильны и умом не обделены. Не поможете ли нам?
The Canyon Guides#003.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#004.src: You see, a lost man is staking out in a camp on the nearby cliff faces. It pains us to see him, but we are unable to reach him.
The Canyon Guides#004.dst: Видите ли, в лагере на ближних скалах застрял заблудившийся человек. Нам больно на него смотреть, но добраться до него мы не можем.
The Canyon Guides#004.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#005.src: The canyon creatures there are ruthless, and we are not suited to physical combat. We would be able to reach him, but we would be stranded ourselves.
The Canyon Guides#005.dst: Твари каньона там безжалостны, а к бою мы непригодны. Дойти мы бы смогли, но и сами застряли бы там.
The Canyon Guides#005.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#006.src: We ask you to guide Seluc to us. We shall send you to him, and you will bring him here. If you wish to help, you will be rewarded for your time.
The Canyon Guides#006.dst: Просим вас привести Seluc к нам. Мы отправим вас к нему, а вы приведёте его сюда. Если поможете, ваш труд будет вознаграждён.
The Canyon Guides#006.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#007.src: Find Seluc in his camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canyon Guides#007.dst: Найди Seluc в его лагере на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canyon Guides#008.src: Who's that? Am I finally being rescued!?
The Canyon Guides#008.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#009.src: Wait, a human! Ugh, I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up. What did you do, take a day off cliff diving?
The Canyon Guides#009.dst: Стоп, человек! Тьфу, зря надеялся. Что, выходной от прыжков с утёсов?
The Canyon Guides#009.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#010.src: If you really did intend to rescue me, you've assuredly wasted both our time.
The Canyon Guides#010.dst: Если это спасение, то ты зря тратишь наше время.
The Canyon Guides#010.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#011.src: If you really want to make yourself useful, get a Bantisu monk over here! You're good at that, right? Fetching things and people?
The Canyon Guides#011.dst: Хочешь пользы - приведи сюда монаха Bantisu! У вас ведь это хорошо выходит, да? Бегать за вещами и людьми?
The Canyon Guides#011.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#013.src: You're trying to kill me, aren't you?! What, can't take hearing the truth? Now my coat is drenched, and! AND!
The Canyon Guides#013.dst: Ты хочешь меня убить, да?! Что, правду слышать не можешь? Теперь пальто насквозь мокрое, и! И!
The Canyon Guides#013.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#014.src: These Jinko are going to pounce any second now!! I haven't got a weapon, were you expecting me to rush off and get into a rumble?!
The Canyon Guides#014.dst: Эти Jinko вот-вот набросятся!! У меня даже оружия нет, ты что, думаешь, я кинусь с ними драться?!
The Canyon Guides#014.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#015.src: Kill them! Kill then now! And get me OUT OF HERE! You got me into this mess, now get me out!!
The Canyon Guides#015.dst: Убей их! Убей сейчас же! И вытащи меня ОТСЮДА! Из-за тебя я в этой каше, так вытаскивай!!
The Canyon Guides#015.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#017.src: Ugh, all that danger got me flustered. I'm sweating in this coat...and it's all soaked already. Let me just...
The Canyon Guides#017.dst: Тьфу, от такой опасности меня аж в жар бросило. Потею в этом пальто… а оно и так мокрое. Сниму-ка…
The Canyon Guides#017.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#018.src: ...set that aside. Congratulations, human! I'm probably never getting that coat back, and it cost me a pretty sum. Thanks for nothing.
The Canyon Guides#018.dst: …и отложу. Поздравляю, человек! Пальто я, небось, уже не верну, а стоило оно немало. Премного благодарен.
The Canyon Guides#018.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#019.src: All this walking...I'm taking a break here. You forced me to jump off a cliff, I get to force you to slow down. It's only fair! Besides that...
The Canyon Guides#019.dst: Сколько ходьбы… Я тут передохну. Из-за тебя я прыгал с утёса, а теперь я заставлю тебя сбавить шаг. Всё честно! К тому же…
The Canyon Guides#019.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#020.src: I only even came here just to see the view. At least that can't be ruined. Still, some vacation this turned out to be...
The Canyon Guides#020.dst: Я вообще приехал сюда ради вида. Уж его-то не испортить. И всё же, ну и отпуск получился…
The Canyon Guides#020.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#021.src: Wait, what in the world- What's going on?!
The Canyon Guides#021.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#023.src: NO ONE TELLS ME ANYTHING! The brochure didn't mention earthquakes, YOU didn't tell me either, but what was I expecting from a human anyways?!
The Canyon Guides#023.dst: МНЕ НИКТО НИЧЕГО НЕ ГОВОРИТ! В буклете про землетрясения ни слова, ТЫ тоже молчишь, но чего ещё ждать от человека?!
The Canyon Guides#023.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#024.src: I'm not a carrot! You'd better get me out of h- ...wait, wait, those...
The Canyon Guides#024.dst: Я не морковка! Лучше вытащи меня отс- …стой, стой, это же…
The Canyon Guides#024.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#025.src: H-Hobgoblins. Hobgoblins HOBGOBLINS THERE'S HOBGOBLINS!! KILL THEM! AAAAH! AAH! AAAAAAH!
The Canyon Guides#025.dst: Х-хобгоблины. Хобгоблины ХОБГОБЛИНЫ ТАМ ХОБГОБЛИНЫ!! УБЕЙ ИХ! АААА! ААА! АААААА!
The Canyon Guides#025.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#026.src: Sweet baby bovine I just saw my life flash before my eyes. Ugh...now pull me up. I'm stuck. But easy on the goods, I'm NOT a carrot I'll remind you!
The Canyon Guides#026.dst: Святые коровки, у меня вся жизнь перед глазами пронеслась. Тьфу… тяни меня. Я застрял. Но полегче, напоминаю: я НЕ морковка!
The Canyon Guides#026.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#027.src: Great. I'm SO grateful to be covered in mud and hobgoblin blood, and to be lacking my coat, AND to be stuck with a human.
The Canyon Guides#027.dst: Прекрасно. Я ТАК благодарен: весь в грязи и крови хобгоблинов, без пальто и ВДОБАВОК застрял с человеком.
The Canyon Guides#027.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#028.src: Just get me out of here already. See, if an actual Bantisu monk had come down I'd probably be at home already, sipping tea by the fire!
The Canyon Guides#028.dst: Просто вытащи меня уже. Вот пришёл бы настоящий монах Bantisu - я бы уже сидел дома и пил чай у огня!
The Canyon Guides#028.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#029.src: I know you humans are reckless, but I'd have expected you to have SOME concern, since you supposedly wanted to rescue me.
The Canyon Guides#029.dst: Знаю, люди безрассудны, но раз ты вроде как спасаешь меня, я ждал хоть КАПЛИ заботы.
The Canyon Guides#029.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#030.src: Ugh, my feet are killing me. Maybe this hike wouldn't be so bad if SOMEONE hadn't knocked me into the lake and made me lose my shoes!
The Canyon Guides#030.dst: Тьфу, ноги отваливаются. Может, поход был бы не так плох, если бы КОЕ-КТО не столкнул меня в озеро и я не потерял ботинки!
The Canyon Guides#030.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#034.src: ...perfect. Just GREAT! The only available path to the temple, and now it's blocked off! Just my luck!!
The Canyon Guides#034.dst: …прекрасно. Просто ЧУДЕСНО! Единственная тропа к храму, и её завалило! Вот везёт-то!!
The Canyon Guides#034.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#035.src: ...wait. You're reckless and willing to endanger your life, right? There's no way that I could possibly use them, but I see some ledges.
The Canyon Guides#035.dst: …стоп. Тебе ведь жизни не жаль, так? Я по этим уступам в жизни не пройду, но я их вижу.
The Canyon Guides#035.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#036.src: See, just to the side of the rockslide? There's some ledges to jump around on.
The Canyon Guides#036.dst: Видишь, сбоку от обвала? Там уступы, по ним можно прыгать.
The Canyon Guides#036.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#037.src: Find a way to get Seluc past the blockage.
The Canyon Guides#037.dst: Найди способ провести Seluc мимо завала.

The Canyon Guides#038.src: ...of course it's a ladder. I'm going to be feeling this climb for weeks...
The Canyon Guides#038.dst: …ну конечно, лестница. Этот подъём мне ещё неделями аукнется…
The Canyon Guides#038.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#039.src: Huff...puff... Well...huff... Wait, there's...there's no way down to the other side! Huff...what a waste!!
The Canyon Guides#039.dst: Уф… пых… Ну… уф… Стой, тут… тут нет спуска на ту сторону! Уф… всё зря!!
The Canyon Guides#039.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#040.src: Can you do ANYTHING right?! There's no way I'm jumping down there, you maniac!
The Canyon Guides#040.dst: Ты хоть ЧТО-НИБУДЬ можешь сделать как надо?! Я туда не прыгну, псих!
The Canyon Guides#040.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#042.src: You...had better count yourself lucky I haven't broken any bones over this. Agh...but that doesn't mean I'm not aching all over!!
The Canyon Guides#042.dst: Тебе… крупно повезло, что я ничего не сломал. Ох… но это не значит, что у меня не болит всё тело!!
The Canyon Guides#042.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#043.src: When I said you were reckless, I was hoping that maybe you'd keep that side of yourself away from other people!!
The Canyon Guides#043.dst: Говоря о безрассудстве, я надеялся, что эту свою сторону ты хоть на других не распространяешь!!
The Canyon Guides#043.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#045.src: At least we're nearly at the temple now. Come on Seluc, silver linings, silver linings. You're nearly away from this freak...
The Canyon Guides#045.dst: Хотя бы до храма уже рукой подать. Давай, Seluc, ищи плюсы, ищи плюсы. Скоро избавишься от этого чудика…
The Canyon Guides#045.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#046.src: Okay, you know what? No. You've put me through QUITE a lot here, human, so you're going to do me a favor and I'm not going to move another step til it's done.
The Canyon Guides#046.dst: Так, знаешь что? Нет. Из-за тебя я ОЧЕНЬ многое вытерпел, человек, так что окажешь мне услугу, и я ни шагу, пока не сделаешь.
The Canyon Guides#046.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#047.src: I paid two weeks wages for that coat you soaked. I'm not leaving here without it, and I'm way too tired to walk back down.
The Canyon Guides#047.dst: За это пальто я отдал двухнедельную зарплату. Без него не уйду, а идти вниз нет сил.
The Canyon Guides#047.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#048.src: So you're going back down to the bottom of the ridge, and you're going to get me my coat. It's the least you could do.
The Canyon Guides#048.dst: Так что спускайся к подножию хребта и принеси моё пальто. Это меньшее, что ты можешь сделать.
The Canyon Guides#048.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#049.src: And be quick about it! I feel like these quakes are going to make the whole mountain collapse. That looks like it opened up a hole straight to the bottom!
The Canyon Guides#049.dst: И побыстрее! Кажется, от этих толчков рухнет вся гора. Вон там, похоже, открылась дыра прямо до низа!
The Canyon Guides#049.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#050.src: Retrieve the coat Seluc left behind at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canyon Guides#052.src: Took you long enough, coat-fetcher! I'm practically frostbitten up here!
The Canyon Guides#052.dst: Долго же ты, носильщик пальто! Я тут почти обморозился!
The Canyon Guides#052.speaker: Seluc
